21.15.97.s: dhiṣṇiyānāṃ nivapana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano vedyanta āgnīdhrīyaṃ nivaped vedyante mārjālīyam |
21.15.97.d: धिष्णियानां निवपन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो वेद्यन्त आग्नीध्रीयं निवपेद् वेद्यन्ते मार्जालीयम् ।
21.15.97.m: Regarding the piling up of the side-hearths: Baudhāyana used to say: He should pile up the āgnīdhrīya hearth at the edge of the altar, and the mārjālīya hearth at the edge of the altar;
having piled up the side-hearths, he should arrange their completion toward the north.

21.15.97.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir antarvedy āgnīdhrīyaṃ nivaped antarvedi mārjālīyam |
21.15.97.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अन्तर्वेद्य् आग्नीध्रीयं निवपेद् अन्तर्वेदि मार्जालीयम् ।
21.15.97.m: On this matter Śālīki used to say: He should pile up the āgnīdhrīya hearth within the altar, and the mārjālīya hearth within the altar;
having piled up the side-hearths, he should not arrange their completion toward the north.

21.15.97.s: vedyai staraṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas trayo dakṣiṇatas traya uttarato madhye saptamaḥ pṛṣṭhyākālaṃ prāñca stṛṇanto gaccheyur iti
21.15.97.d: वेद्यै स्तरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् त्रयो दक्षिणतस् त्रय उत्तरतो मध्ये सप्तमः पृष्ठ्याकालं प्राञ्च स्तृणन्तो गच्छेयुर् इति
21.15.97.m: Regarding the strewing of the altar: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana used to say: Three on the south, three on the north, and the seventh in the middle, along the line of the spine, strewing [the grass] eastward, they should advance.

21.15.97.s: purastād evaināṃ pratyañca stṛṇanto 'bhyavakrāmeyur ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.15.97.d: पुरस्ताद् एवैनां प्रत्यञ्च स्तृणन्तो ऽभ्यवक्रामेयुर् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.15.97.m: Aupamanyava says: "Strewing it from the east toward the west, they should step backward."

21.15.97.s: agnīṣomīyasyājyānāṃ grahaṇe sādana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
21.15.97.d: अग्नीषोमीयस्याज्यानां ग्रहणे सादन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
21.15.97.m: Regarding the taking and setting down of the clarified butter for the victim for Agni-Soma: The rule is that of Baudhāyana.

21.15.97.s: patnīśāla evāgnīṣomīyasyājyāni gṛhṇīyāt tāni khare sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.15.97.d: पत्नीशाल एवाग्नीषोमीयस्याज्यानि गृह्णीयात् तानि खरे सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.15.97.m: Śālīki says: "He should take the clarified butter for the victim for Agni-Soma in the hall of the sacrificer's wife itself, and set them down on the mound."

21.15.97.s: samanvānayana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nādriyeteti śālīkiḥ ||
21.15.97.d: समन्वानयन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नाद्रियेतेति शालीकिः ॥
21.15.97.m: Regarding the bringing [of the sacrificer and his wife] along: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "He should not take heed [of this]."

21.15.98.s: ardhastanavratapradāna iti || samanvānīya vāsamanvānīya vā purāṇagārhapatyam ardhastanavrataṃ prayacched iti baudhāyanas |
21.15.98.d: अर्धस्तनव्रतप्रदान इति ॥ समन्वानीय वासमन्वानीय वा पुराणगार्हपत्यम् अर्धस्तनव्रतं प्रयच्छेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.15.98.m: Regarding the giving of the half-teat fast-milk: Baudhāyana says that whether he brings [them] along or does not bring [them] along, he should give the half-teat fast-milk [near] the old gārhapatya fire;
Śālīki says: "He should not give the half-teat fast-milk."

21.15.98.s: vaisarjanānām̐ homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya catvāri caturgṛhītāni juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.15.98.d: वैसर्जनानाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य चत्वारि चतुर्गृहीतानि जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.15.98.m: Regarding the offering of the parting libations: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "He should offer four fourfold-drawn portions."

21.15.98.s: vasatīvarīṇām anusam̐haraṇa iti || anusam̐hared iti baudhāyanas |
21.15.98.d: वसतीवरीणाम् अनुसँहरण इति ॥ अनुसँहरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.15.98.m: Regarding the bringing together of the vasatīvarī waters: Baudhāyana says that he should bring them together;
Śālīki says: "He should not bring them together."

21.15.98.s: vapānāṃ parihoma iti || tāṃtāṃ parijuhuyād iti baudhāyanas |
21.15.98.d: वपानां परिहोम इति ॥ तांतां परिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.15.98.m: Regarding the circum-offering of the omenta: Baudhāyana says that he should circum-offer each of them;
Śālīki says: "At the beginning and at the end."

21.15.98.s: hṛdayaśūlānām udvāsana iti || ekaikaśa udvāsayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
21.15.98.d: हृदयशूलानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ एकैकश उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनः
21.15.98.m: Regarding the removal of the heart-spits: Baudhāyana says that he should remove them one by one;

21.15.98.s: vasatīvarīṇāṃ pariharaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana evam evaināḥ pariharann agreṇa yūpam̐ sādayitvā jaghanena gārhapatyam upasādyāgnīdhre sannā abhimṛśed yajñe jāgṛteti ||
21.15.98.d: वसतीवरीणां परिहरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन एवम् एवैनाः परिहरन्न् अग्रेण यूपँ सादयित्वा जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् उपसाद्याग्नीध्रे सन्ना अभिमृशेद् यज्ञे जागृतेति ॥
21.15.98.m: Regarding the carrying around of the vasatīvarī waters: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: Carrying them around in this very way, having set them down in front of the sacrificial post, having set them down behind the gārhapatya fire, he should touch them when set down in the āgnīdhra shed with, "Watch over the sacrifice!"

21.16.98.s: savanīyasyājyānāṃ grahaṇe sādana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
21.16.98.d: सवनीयस्याज्यानां ग्रहणे सादन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
21.16.98.m: Regarding the taking and setting down of the clarified butter for the victim of the soma-day: The rule is that of Baudhāyana.

21.16.98.s: āgnīdhra eva savanīyasyājyāni gṛhṇīyāt tāni khare sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.16.98.d: आग्नीध्र एव सवनीयस्याज्यानि गृह्णीयात् तानि खरे सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.16.98.m: Śālīki says: "He should take the clarified butter for the victim of the soma-day in the āgnīdhra shed itself; he should set them down on the mound."

21.16.99.s: audumbarāṇāṃ mahāparidhīnāṃ paridhāna iti || sūtram ācāryayos |
21.16.99.d: औदुम्बराणां महापरिधीनां परिधान इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् ।
21.16.99.m: Regarding the placing of the great enclosing sticks of udumbara wood: The rule is that of both teachers.

21.16.99.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sruṅmantrā evaite syur iti ||
21.16.99.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः स्रुङ्मन्त्रा एवैते स्युर् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: On this matter Aupamanyava used to say: "These should just be the formulas for the ladles."

21.16.99.s: rājña upāvaharaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ prātaḥsavana eva sarvebhyaḥ savanebhyo rājānam upāvahared iti ||
21.16.99.d: राज्ञ उपावहरण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः प्रातःसवन एव सर्वेभ्यः सवनेभ्यो राजानम् उपावहरेद् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: Regarding the taking down of King [Soma]: The rule is that of both teachers. On this matter Aupamanyava used to say: "At the morning pressing alone, he should take down King [Soma] for all the pressings."

21.16.99.s: pañcahotur homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya caturhotāram̐ hutvā pañcahotāraṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.16.99.d: पञ्चहोतुर् होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य चतुर्होतारँ हुत्वा पञ्चहोतारं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.16.99.m: Regarding the offering of the pañcahotṛ formula: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "Having offered with the caturhotṛ formula, he should offer with the pañcahotṛ formula."

21.16.99.s: prātaranuvākasyopākaraṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhārtabhāgīputras tūṣṇīkenaikakapālena prātaranuvākam upākuryād iti ||
21.16.99.d: प्रातरनुवाकस्योपाकरण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहार्तभागीपुत्रस् तूष्णीकेनैककपालेन प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकुर्याद् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: Regarding the bringing forward of the morning litany: The rule is that of both teachers. On this matter Ārtabhāgīputra used to say: "He should bring forward the morning litany silently with an offering-cake on one potsherd."

21.16.99.s: savanīyānāṃ nirvapaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ prātaḥsavana eva sarvebhyaḥ savanebhyaḥ savanīyān nirvaped iti ||
21.16.99.d: सवनीयानां निर्वपण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः प्रातःसवन एव सर्वेभ्यः सवनेभ्यः सवनीयान् निर्वपेद् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: Regarding the apportioning of the offerings of the soma-day: The rule is that of both teachers. On this matter Aupamanyava used to say: "At the morning pressing alone, he should apportion the offerings of the soma-day for all the pressings."

21.16.99.s: teṣāṃ vrīhiṣv eva haviṣkṛtam udvādayaty upodyacchante yavān iti ||
21.16.99.d: तेषां व्रीहिष्व् एव हविष्कृतम् उद्वादयत्य् उपोद्यच्छन्ते यवान् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: "Among them, he makes the summoner of the oblation-maker resound over the rice grains only, while they take up the barley grains"—

21.16.99.s: sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana āvapanaprabhṛti yaveṣu mantrakarmābhyāvarteta tantraṃ tu haviṣkṛt syād iti ||
21.16.99.d: सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन आवपनप्रभृति यवेषु मन्त्रकर्माभ्यावर्तेत तन्त्रं तु हविष्कृत् स्याद् इति ॥
21.16.99.m: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: From the pouring in onward, the ritual acts with formulas should be repeated over the barley, but the summoner of the oblation-maker should be common [to both].

21.16.99.s: āpyaninayana iti || jaghanena gārhapatyam āpyebhyo ninayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.16.99.d: आप्यनिनयन इति ॥ जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् आप्येभ्यो निनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.16.99.m: Regarding the pouring out for the Āpyas: Baudhāyana says that he should pour it out for the Āpyas behind the gārhapatya fire;

21.16.100.s: agreṇātihāyeti śālīkis | agreṇa vā jaghanena vety aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.16.100.d: अग्रेणातिहायेति शालीकिस् । अग्रेण वा जघनेन वेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.16.100.m: Śālīki says, "Having bypassed in front"; Aupamanyava says, "Either in front or behind."

21.16.100.s: pātrāṇām̐ sādana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ khare pātrāṇi sādayet
21.16.100.d: पात्राणाँ सादन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः खरे पात्राणि सादयेत्
21.16.100.m: Regarding the setting down of the vessels: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: He should set down the vessels on the mound;
he should take them according to need.

21.16.100.s: athaikadhanān gṛhṇāti | indrāya vo juṣṭān gṛhṇāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
21.16.100.d: अथैकधनान् गृह्णाति । इन्द्राय वो जुष्टान् गृह्णामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
21.16.100.m: Now he draws the ekadhana waters, either with: "I take you, agreeable to Indra," or silently.
The former procedure belongs to Baudhāyana, the latter to Śālīki.

21.17.100.s: aptoḥ praskandana iti || hotṛcamasād atrāptuṃ praskandayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.17.100.d: अप्तोः प्रस्कन्दन इति ॥ होतृचमसाद् अत्राप्तुं प्रस्कन्दयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.17.100.m: Regarding the dropping of the aptu: Baudhāyana says that here he should cause the aptu to drop from the hotṛ's cup;

21.17.100.s: kratukaraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yathākratv evāsya kratukaraṇāni kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.17.100.d: क्रतुकरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यथाक्रत्व् एवास्य क्रतुकरणानि कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.17.100.m: Regarding the rite-making: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "He should perform the rite-makings for him according to the particular rite only."

21.17.100.s: dadhigrahasya grahaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana audumbareṇainaṃ pātreṇa gṛhṇīyād dhutvā caitat pātram atraivānuprahared iti ||
21.17.100.d: दधिग्रहस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन औदुम्बरेणैनं पात्रेण गृह्णीयाद् धुत्वा चैतत् पात्रम् अत्रैवानुप्रहरेद् इति ॥
21.17.100.m: Regarding the drawing of the curd-cup: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: He should draw it with a vessel of udumbara wood, and having offered, he should throw this vessel into the fire right here.

21.17.100.s: dakṣiṇāyai dāna iti || sūtraṃ dvaidham evaitad bhavati ||
21.17.100.d: दक्षिणायै दान इति ॥ सूत्रं द्वैधम् एवैतद् भवति ॥
21.17.100.m: Regarding the giving of the priestly gift: The rule on this is twofold.

21.17.100.s: tāsu nigrābhyāsu yajamānaṃ vācayatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
21.17.100.d: तासु निग्राभ्यासु यजमानं वाचयतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
21.17.100.m: "He makes the sacrificer recite over those nigrābhyā waters"—The rule is that of Śālīki.

21.17.100.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyana ūrau vorasi vopanigṛhya tāsu nigrabhyāsu yajamānaṃ vācayatīti ||
21.17.100.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन ऊरौ वोरसि वोपनिगृह्य तासु निग्रभ्यासु यजमानं वाचयतीति ॥
21.17.100.m: On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: Holding [them] close either on the lap or on the chest, he makes the sacrificer recite over those nigrābhyā waters.

21.17.100.s: rājño nirvapaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ prātaḥsavana eva sarvebhyaḥ savanebhyo rājānaṃ nirvaped iti ||
21.17.100.d: राज्ञो निर्वपण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः प्रातःसवन एव सर्वेभ्यः सवनेभ्यो राजानं निर्वपेद् इति ॥
21.17.100.m: Regarding the apportioning of King [Soma]: The rule is that of both teachers. On this matter Aupamanyava used to say: "At the morning pressing alone, he should apportion King [Soma] for all the pressings."

21.17.101.s: so 'm̐śau skanne vācayatīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | upām̐śāv evām̐śau skanne vācayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.17.101.d: सो ऽँशौ स्कन्ने वाचयतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । उपाँशाव् एवाँशौ स्कन्ने वाचयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.17.101.m: "When a shoot has dropped, he makes him recite"—The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "Only when a shoot has dropped for the upāṃśu cup should he make him recite."

21.17.101.s: upām̐śv antaryāmayor homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ubhāv evodite juhuyād iti śālīkis |
21.17.101.d: उपाँश्व् अन्तर्यामयोर् होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । उभाव् एवोदिते जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.17.101.m: Regarding the offering of the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "He should offer both after the sun has risen";
Aupamanyava says: "He should offer both before the sun has risen."

21.17.101.s: āgrayaṇasya grahaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano dvayor dhārayoḥ prātaḥsavane gṛhṇīyāt tisṛṇāṃ mādhyaṃdine savane catasṛṇāṃ tṛtīyasavana iti ||
21.17.101.d: आग्रयणस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो द्वयोर् धारयोः प्रातःसवने गृह्णीयात् तिसृणां माध्यंदिने सवने चतसृणां तृतीयसवन इति ॥
21.17.101.m: Regarding the drawing of the āgrayaṇa cup: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana used to say: In two streams he should draw at the morning pressing, in three at the midday pressing, in four at the third pressing.

21.17.101.s: drapsānumantraṇīyāsv iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sruvāhutīr evaitā juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.17.101.d: द्रप्सानुमन्त्रणीयास्व् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य स्रुवाहुतीर् एवैता जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.17.101.m: Regarding the [formulas] for contemplating the drops: The rule is that of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: "He should offer these as ladle libations."

21.18.101.m: Regarding the drawing of the pavamāna cups: The rule is that of Baudhāyana.
Śālīki says: "Having wiped them around while shared, he should set them down."

21.18.101.s: saṃtanīnām̐ homa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano vasatīvarīr apy etair mantrair avanayed iti ||
21.18.101.d: संतनीनाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो वसतीवरीर् अप्य् एतैर् मन्त्रैर् अवनयेद् इति ॥
21.18.101.m: Regarding the offering of the continuous oblations: the sūtra is Śālīki's; but in this regard Baudhāyana said: one should pour down the vasatīvarī waters as well with these mantras.

21.18.101.s: pavamānānām upākaraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sadasa eva barhiṣī ādāyopākuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.18.101.d: पवमानानाम् उपाकरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सदस एव बर्हिषी आदायोपाकुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.18.101.m: Regarding the bringing forward of the pavamāna chants: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; Śālīki says that taking two blades of sacrificial grass from the sadas shed itself, he should bring it forward.

21.18.101.s: brahmaṇa upaveśana iti || yathā sadasy evam upaviśed iti baudhāyanas |
21.18.101.d: ब्रह्मण उपवेशन इति ॥ यथा सदस्य् एवम् उपविशेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.18.101.m: Regarding the sitting down of the brahman priest: Baudhāyana says that he should sit down just as in the sadas shed;
Śālīki says just as in the new and full moon rituals.

21.18.102.s: yajamānasyopaveśana iti || yathāsadasy evam upaviśed iti baudhāyanas |
21.18.102.d: यजमानस्योपवेशन इति ॥ यथासदस्य् एवम् उपविशेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.18.102.m: Regarding the sitting down of the sacrificer: Baudhāyana says that he should sit down just as in the sadas shed;
Śālīki says just as in the new and full moon rituals.

21.18.102.s: athodgātre vā prastotre vā barhiṣī prayacchatīti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
21.18.102.d: अथोद्गात्रे वा प्रस्तोत्रे वा बर्हिषी प्रयच्छतीति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
21.18.102.m: Regarding [the rule]: "Then he gives two blades of sacrificial grass to either the udgātṛ or the prastotṛ priest": the former procedure is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

21.18.102.s: ṛksāmayor upastaraṇam asi mithunasya prajātyai | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
21.18.102.d: ऋक्सामयोर् उपस्तरणम् असि मिथुनस्य प्रजात्यै । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
21.18.102.m: Regarding whether [he gives them] with "You are the spread of ṛc and sāman for the procreation of the couple", or silently:
the former procedure is Śālīki's, the latter Baudhāyana's.
Regarding [the rule]: "When the fifth [verse] is being introduced, he makes him recite": the sūtra is Baudhāyana's;

21.18.102.s: yasyām eva kasyāṃ cid vācayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.18.102.d: यस्याम् एव कस्यां चिद् वाचयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.18.102.m: Śālīki says that he may make him recite at any [verse] whatsoever.

21.18.102.s: saptahotur homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | anusavanam eva saptahotāraṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.18.102.d: सप्तहोतुर् होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अनुसवनम् एव सप्तहोतारं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.18.102.m: Regarding the offering of the saptahotṛ formula: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; Śālīki says that he should offer the saptahotṛ formula at each soma press.

21.18.102.s: dhiṣṇiyānāṃ viharaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārān ādāya tata āgnīdhrīye praskandayed athānupūrvam itareṣu
21.18.102.d: धिष्णियानां विहरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन आग्नीध्रीयाद् अङ्गारान् आदाय तत आग्नीध्रीये प्रस्कन्दयेद् अथानुपूर्वम् इतरेषु
21.18.102.m: Regarding the distributing of the side-hearths: Baudhāyana said: having taken embers from the āgnīdhra fire, he should scatter some from there onto the āgnīdhra fire, and then onto the others in succession;

21.18.102.s: dhiṣṇiyān vihṛtyodīcīnasam̐sthatāṃ kuryād iti | atro ha smāha śālīkir āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārān ādāya tata āgnīdhrīye praskandayed athānupūrvam itareṣu
21.18.102.d: धिष्णियान् विहृत्योदीचीनसँस्थतां कुर्याद् इति । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् आग्नीध्रीयाद् अङ्गारान् आदाय तत आग्नीध्रीये प्रस्कन्दयेद् अथानुपूर्वम् इतरेषु
21.18.102.m: having distributed the side-hearths, he should arrange their completion towards the north; but in this regard Śālīki said: having taken embers from the āgnīdhra fire, he should scatter some from there onto the āgnīdhra fire, and then onto the others in succession;

21.18.102.s: dhiṣṇiyān vihṛtya na codīcīnasam̐sthatāṃ kuryād iti ||
21.18.102.d: धिष्णियान् विहृत्य न चोदीचीनसँस्थतां कुर्याद् इति ॥
21.18.102.m: having distributed the side-hearths, he should not arrange their completion towards the north.

21.18.103.s: dhiṣṇiyānāṃ vyāghāraṇa iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
21.18.103.d: धिष्णियानां व्याघारण इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
21.18.103.m: Regarding the sprinkling of clarified butter on the side-hearths: the former procedure is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

21.18.103.s: svaruraśanasyotpādana iti || yūpaḥ svaruraśanam utpādayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
21.18.103.d: स्वरुरशनस्योत्पादन इति ॥ यूपः स्वरुरशनम् उत्पादयेद् इति बौधायनः
21.18.103.m: Regarding the production of the sacrificial chip and the rope: Baudhāyana says that the sacrificial post should produce the sacrificial chip and the rope;

21.18.103.s: paśur iti śālīkis tantram ity aupamanyavas | devatety aupamanyavīputraḥ ||
21.18.103.d: पशुर् इति शालीकिस् तन्त्रम् इत्य् औपमन्यवस् । देवतेत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रः ॥
21.18.103.m: Śālīki says the animal; Aupamanyava says the main ritual; Aupamanyavīputra says the deity.

21.19.103.s: sarpaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | aparadvārika eva yajamānaḥ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.103.d: सर्पण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अपरद्वारिक एव यजमानः स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.103.m: Regarding the gliding: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; Śālīki says that the sacrificer should remain only at the western door.

21.19.103.s: tārtīyasavanikeṣūkthyavigraheṣv iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prasarped eva tārtīyasavanikebhya ukthyavigrahebhyaḥ ṣoḍaśine rātriparyāyebhyo rāthaṃtarāya saṃdhaya iti |
21.19.103.d: तार्तीयसवनिकेषूक्थ्यविग्रहेष्व् इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रसर्पेद् एव तार्तीयसवनिकेभ्य उक्थ्यविग्रहेभ्यः षोडशिने रात्रिपर्यायेभ्यो राथंतराय संधय इति ।
21.19.103.m: Regarding the ukthya-divisions belonging to the third pressing: Baudhāyana said: he should indeed glide for the ukthya-divisions belonging to the third pressing, for the ṣoḍaśin, for the nocturnal rounds, and for the twilight chant set to the rathaṃtara saman;

21.19.103.s: atro ha smāha śālīkis tṛtīyasavanātivṛddhir evaiṣā bhavati
21.19.103.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिस् तृतीयसवनातिवृद्धिर् एवैषा भवति
21.19.103.m: in this regard Śālīki said: this is merely an extension of the third pressing;

21.19.103.s: yad eva tṛtīyasavane prasarpet tat prasṛptam eva teṣām̐ syād iti
21.19.103.d: यद् एव तृतीयसवने प्रसर्पेत् तत् प्रसृप्तम् एव तेषाँ स्याद् इति
21.19.103.m: in that he glides at the third pressing, that itself counts as his gliding for them;

21.19.103.s: prātaḥsavana eva sarvebhyaḥ savavebhyaḥ saṃprasarped ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.19.103.d: प्रातःसवन एव सर्वेभ्यः सववेभ्यः संप्रसर्पेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.19.103.m: Aupamanyava says that he should glide forward for all the soma pressings right at the morning pressing.

21.19.103.s: āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti || mantravatī ca syāt sarvāṇi ca savanāny anusamiyād iti baudhāyanas
21.19.103.d: आमिक्षायै मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवती च स्यात् सर्वाणि च सवनान्य् अनुसमियाद् इति बौधायनस्
21.19.103.m: Regarding whether the clotted curds are accompanied by mantra or not: Baudhāyana says that it should be accompanied by mantra and should go along with all the soma pressings;

21.19.103.s: tūṣṇīkā ca syāt sarvāṇi ca savanāny anusamiyād iti śālīkis |
21.19.103.d: तूष्णीका च स्यात् सर्वाणि च सवनान्य् अनुसमियाद् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.19.103.m: Śālīki says that it should be silent and should go along with all the soma pressings.

21.19.104.s: mantravatī ca syāt prātaḥsavane caivaiṣā syād ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.19.104.d: मन्त्रवती च स्यात् प्रातःसवने चैवैषा स्याद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.19.104.m: "It should be accompanied by a formula, and this should take place only at the morning pressing," says Aupamanyava.

21.19.104.s: savanīyānām udvāsana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nānāpātrīṣv eva savanīyānudvāsayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.104.d: सवनीयानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नानापात्रीष्व् एव सवनीयानुद्वासयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.104.m: Regarding the taking off of the pressing oblations: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "One should take off the pressing oblations only into different dishes," says Śālīki.

21.19.104.s: prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyeti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya prātaḥsāvasya | ity eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.104.d: प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य प्रातःसावस्य । इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.104.m: Regarding "In the morning, of the morning pressing...": The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "He should say only 'Of the morning pressing,'" says Śālīki.

21.19.104.s: savanīyānām anusam̐haraṇa iti || anusam̐hared iti baudhāyanas |
21.19.104.d: सवनीयानाम् अनुसँहरण इति ॥ अनुसँहरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.19.104.m: Regarding the collecting together of the pressing oblations: "He should collect them together," says Baudhāyana;
"He should not collect them together," says Śālīki.
Regarding the drawing of the pratinirgrāhya cups: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's;

21.19.104.s: dvidevatyebhya eva pratinirgrāhyān nigṛhṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.104.d: द्विदेवत्येभ्य एव प्रतिनिर्ग्राह्यान् निगृह्णीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.104.m: "He should draw the pratinirgrāhya cups only for the two-deity cups," says Śālīki.

21.19.104.s: āghāra iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya grahād evaitam āghāram āghārayed iti śālīkis |
21.19.104.d: आघार इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ग्रहाद् एवैतम् आघारम् आघारयेद् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.19.104.m: Regarding the continuous libation: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "One should pour this continuous libation directly from the cup," says Śālīki;
"From the droṇakalaśa trough with a spoon-vessel," says Aupamanyava;

21.19.104.s: yajur evaitaj japen naitam āghāram āghārayed ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
21.19.104.d: यजुर् एवैतज् जपेन् नैतम् आघारम् आघारयेद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
21.19.104.m: "He should merely mutter this yajus formula; he should not pour this continuous libation," says Āñjīgavi.

21.19.105.s: sam̐srāvasyāpidhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yāvān eva sam̐srāvaḥ syāt tam apidadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.105.d: सँस्रावस्यापिधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यावान् एव सँस्रावः स्यात् तम् अपिदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.105.m: Regarding the covering of the residue: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "Whatever residue there is, that he should cover," says Śālīki.

21.19.105.s: camasānām āyātana iti || agreṇa srucaḥ prāca āyātayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.19.105.d: चमसानाम् आयातन इति ॥ अग्रेण स्रुचः प्राच आयातयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.19.105.m: Regarding the alignment of the cups: "He should align them towards the east in front of the ladles," says Baudhāyana;

21.19.105.s: jaghanena sruca udīca āyātayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.19.105.d: जघनेन स्रुच उदीच आयातयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.19.105.m: "He should align them towards the north behind the ladles," says Śālīki.

21.20.105.s: grahayoḥ saṃdhāna iti || aratnī ca grahau ca saṃdadhyātām iti baudhāyanas |
21.20.105.d: ग्रहयोः संधान इति ॥ अरत्नी च ग्रहौ च संदध्याताम् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.20.105.m: Regarding the joining of the two cups: "They should join both their forearms and the two cups," says Baudhāyana;

21.20.105.s: śukravato manthivata iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya manthivatas | ity eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.20.105.d: शुक्रवतो मन्थिवत इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य मन्थिवतस् । इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.20.105.m: Regarding "accompanied by the śukra cup, accompanied by the manthin cup...": The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "He should say only 'accompanied by the manthin cup,'" says Śālīki.

21.20.105.s: manthisam̐srāvasya homa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana āhavanīyād evodīco 'ṅgārān nirvartya teṣu manthinaḥ sam̐srāvaṃ juhuyād iti ||
21.20.105.d: मन्थिसँस्रावस्य होम इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन आहवनीयाद् एवोदीचो ऽङ्गारान् निर्वर्त्य तेषु मन्थिनः सँस्रावं जुहुयाद् इति ॥
21.20.105.m: Regarding the offering of the manthin residue: The sūtra is Śālīki's. On this point, Baudhāyana used to say: "Having turned out embers towards the north from the āhavanīya fire, he should offer the residue of the manthin cup on them."

21.20.105.s: hotrakacamasānām̐ homa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ śukrāmanthibhyām enān saha sakṛj juhuyād dvir abhyunnītān iti |
21.20.105.d: होत्रकचमसानाँ होम इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः शुक्रामन्थिभ्याम् एनान् सह सकृज् जुहुयाद् द्विर् अभ्युन्नीतान् इति ।
21.20.105.m: Regarding the offering of the hotraka cups: Baudhāyana used to say: "He should offer them once together with the śukra and manthin cups, [the hotraka cups] having been filled twice."

21.20.105.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir naināñ chukrāmanthibhyām̐ saha sakṛj juhuyād dvir evābhyunnītān iti ||
21.20.105.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् नैनाञ् छुक्रामन्थिभ्याँ सह सकृज् जुहुयाद् द्विर् एवाभ्युन्नीतान् इति ॥
21.20.105.m: On this point Śālīki used to say: "He should not offer them together with the śukra and manthin cups once, but only when they have been filled twice."

21.20.106.s: dvidevatyānāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya prāṇeṣūpanigrāhaṃ dvidevatyān bhakṣayed iti śālīkis |
21.20.106.d: द्विदेवत्यानां भक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य प्राणेषूपनिग्राहं द्विदेवत्यान् भक्षयेद् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.20.106.m: Regarding the consuming of the two-deity cups: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "Holding them down close to the vital breaths, he should consume the two-deity cups," says Śālīki;
"He should consume them with the prolonged consumption formula," says Aupamanyava.

21.20.106.s: athaitāni dvidevatyapātrāṇy ariktāni karotīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
21.20.106.d: अथैतानि द्विदेवत्यपात्राण्य् अरिक्तानि करोतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
21.20.106.m: Regarding "Then he makes these two-deity vessels not empty": The sūtra is Baudhāyana's;
"They should be made not empty with soma itself," says Śālīki.
Regarding "Then he places them on the northern track of the southern havirdhāna cart": [The sūtra is Baudhāyana's;]

21.20.106.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | adhastād evaināny upahavyasya sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.20.106.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अधस्ताद् एवैनान्य् उपहव्यस्य सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.20.106.m: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "He should place them just below the upahavya cup," says Śālīki.

21.20.106.s: vāci vācaṃ dadhāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
21.20.106.d: वाचि वाचं दधामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
21.20.106.m: Regarding whether with "I place speech in speech..." or silently: The former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

21.20.106.s: hotrakacamasānāṃ pratibhakṣaṇa iti || pratibhakṣayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.20.106.d: होत्रकचमसानां प्रतिभक्षण इति ॥ प्रतिभक्षयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.20.106.m: Regarding the mutual consumption of the hotraka cups: "He should consume mutually," says Baudhāyana;
"He should not consume mutually," says Śālīki.

21.20.106.s: pratyabhimarśana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano bhakṣayann eva bhakṣāṇāṃ pāre pratyabhimṛśīteti ||
21.20.106.d: प्रत्यभिमर्शन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो भक्षयन्न् एव भक्षाणां पारे प्रत्यभिमृशीतेति ॥
21.20.106.m: Regarding the touching in return: The sūtra is Śālīki's. On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "While consuming, at the end of the portions consumed, he should touch [his body] in return."

21.20.107.s: aindrāgnasya grahaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha dīrghavātsyo mukhyenainaṃ pātreṇa gṛhṇīyād iti ||
21.20.107.d: ऐन्द्राग्नस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह दीर्घवात्स्यो मुख्येनैनं पात्रेण गृह्णीयाद् इति ॥
21.20.107.m: Regarding the drawing of the cup for Indra and Agni: The sūtra is that of both teachers. On this point Dīrghavātsya used to say: "He should draw it with the chief vessel."

21.20.107.s: nārāśam̐sānām anuprakampana iti || anuprakampayerann iti baudhāyanas |
21.20.107.d: नाराशँसानाम् अनुप्रकम्पन इति ॥ अनुप्रकम्पयेरन्न् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.20.107.m: Regarding the shaking of the nārāśaṃsa cups: "They should shake them," says Baudhāyana;
"They should not shake them," says Śālīki; "They should not even lift them up," says Aupamanyava.

21.21.107.s: mādhyaṃdinīye 'bhiṣava iti || navakṛtvonavakṛtvo 'bhiṣutya nigrābham upeyur iti baudhāyanas |
21.21.107.d: माध्यंदिनीये ऽभिषव इति ॥ नवकृत्वोनवकृत्वो ऽभिषुत्य निग्राभम् उपेयुर् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.21.107.m: Regarding the pressing at the midday service: "Pressing nine times each, they should perform the nigrābha rite," says Baudhāyana;
"An indefinite number of times," says Śālīki.

21.21.107.s: marutvatīyayor grahaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana upariṣṭād evāgrayaṇād gṛhṇīyād iti
21.21.107.d: मरुत्वतीययोर् ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन उपरिष्टाद् एवाग्रयणाद् गृह्णीयाद् इति
21.21.107.m:
With regard to the drawing of the two Marutvatīya soma-cups:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.
On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "He should draw them only after the Āgrayaṇa soma-cup,"
"for that is their proper place for being drawn."

With regard to the rule: "When the eighth [verse] has been introduced, he makes him recite":
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.

21.21.107.s: yasyām eva kasyāṃ cid vācayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.21.107.d: यस्याम् एव कस्यां चिद् वाचयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.21.107.m: "He may make him recite at any [verse] whatever," says Śālīki.

21.21.107.s: dadhigharmasya grahaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āgnīdhra enaṃ gṛhṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ
21.21.107.d: दधिघर्मस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आग्नीध्र एनं गृह्णीयाद् इति शालीकिः
21.21.107.m:
With regard to the drawing of the dadhigharma:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"The Āgnīdhra priest should draw it," says Śālīki.
"Having screened [the space] and performed the pacification on both sides, the Āgnīdhra priest alone [should draw it]," says Aupamanyava.

21.21.107.s: dadhigharmasya caryāyā iti || upām̐śu cared iti baudhāyanas |
21.21.107.d: दधिघर्मस्य चर्याया इति ॥ उपाँशु चरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.21.107.m:
With regard to the performance of the dadhigharma:
"He should perform it in a whisper," says Baudhāyana.

21.21.107.s: dadhigharmasya bhakṣaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'vadhrabhakṣaṇenaivetare bhakṣayeyur yajamāna eva pratyakṣaṃ bhakṣayed araṇye 'nuvākyena mantreṇeti ||
21.21.107.d: दधिघर्मस्य भक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽवध्रभक्षणेनैवेतरे भक्षयेयुर् यजमान एव प्रत्यक्षं भक्षयेद् अरण्ये ऽनुवाक्येन मन्त्रेणेति ॥
21.21.107.m:
With regard to the consuming of the dadhigharma:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.
On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "The others should consume only by touching with their fingers; only the sacrificer should consume directly, with the mantra belonging to the Araṇye'nuvākya."

21.21.108.s: dakṣiṇānām atyākaraṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana ekām eva dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāpathenātyākuryāt |
21.21.108.d: दक्षिणानाम् अत्याकरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन एकाम् एव दक्षिणां दक्षिणापथेनात्याकुर्यात् ।

21.21.108.m: then the others should proceed according to available space."

21.21.108.s: saṃcara iti || nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu yathārtham̐ saṃcarerann iti baudhāyanas |
21.21.108.d: संचर इति ॥ नीतासु दक्षिणासु यथार्थँ संचरेरन्न् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.21.108.m:
With regard to the movement:
"When the sacrificial gifts have been led past, they should move about according to their needs," says Baudhāyana.

21.21.108.s: nāsam̐sthite some 'dhvaryuḥ pratyaṅ sado 'tīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.21.108.d: नासँस्थिते सोमे ऽध्वर्युः प्रत्यङ् सदो ऽतीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.21.108.m: "As long as the soma ritual is not completed, the adhvaryu priest should not cross the sadas shed towards the west," says Śālīki.

21.21.108.s: kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ prāsana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.21.108.d: कृष्णविषाणायाः प्रासन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नीतासु दक्षिणासु चात्वाले कृष्णविषाणां प्रास्येद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.21.108.m:
With regard to casting away the black-antelope horn:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"When the sacrificial gifts have been led past, he should cast the black-antelope horn into the pit," says Śālīki.

21.21.108.s: ātreyasya saṃvadana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas trir evāvyatiṣajan pṛcchet ka ātreyaḥ ka ātreyas | iti ||
21.21.108.d: आत्रेयस्य संवदन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् त्रिर् एवाव्यतिषजन् पृच्छेत् क आत्रेयः क आत्रेयस् । इति ॥
21.21.108.m:
With regard to conversing with an Ātreya:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.
On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "Without interrupting, he should ask three times: 'Who is an Ātreya? Who is an Ātreya?'"

21.22.109.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano mahartvigbhya enā dadyān na hotrakān anusaṃcarerann iti
21.22.109.d: दक्षिणानां दान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो महर्त्विग्भ्य एना दद्यान् न होत्रकान् अनुसंचरेरन्न् इति
21.22.109.m:
With regard to the distribution of the sacrificial gifts:
Baudhāyana used to say: "He should give them to the principal officiating priests; they should not go around to the assistant priests."

21.22.109.s: na ca hotrakān anusaṃcareran na ca sadasyāya dadyān na hy etasyānukhyā vijñāyata iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.22.109.d: न च होत्रकान् अनुसंचरेरन् न च सदस्याय दद्यान् न ह्य् एतस्यानुख्या विज्ञायत इति शालीकिः ॥
21.22.109.m: "They should not go around to the assistant priests, nor should he give to the sadasya priest, for no specific mention of him is found [in the brāhmaṇa]," says Śālīki.

21.22.109.s: marutvatīyayor homa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yam evādhvaryur juhuyāt sa vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛtaḥ syād athetaro 'nanuvaṣaṭkṛtaḥ syād iti |
21.22.109.d: मरुत्वतीययोर् होम इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यम् एवाध्वर्युर् जुहुयात् स वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृतः स्याद् अथेतरो ऽननुवषट्कृतः स्याद् इति ।
21.22.109.m:
With regard to the offering of the two Marutvatīya soma-cups:
Baudhāyana used to say: "The one which the adhvaryu priest offers should have the vaṣaṭ call and the second vaṣaṭ call uttered for it, while the other should be without the second vaṣaṭ call."

21.22.109.s: ubhāv evānanuvaṣaṭkṛtau syātām iti śālīkis | ubhāv evānuvaṣatkṛtau syātām ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.22.109.d: उभाव् एवाननुवषट्कृतौ स्याताम् इति शालीकिस् । उभाव् एवानुवषत्कृतौ स्याताम् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.22.109.m:
"Both should be without the second vaṣaṭ call," says Śālīki.
"Both should have the second vaṣaṭ call uttered for them," says Aupamanyava.

21.22.109.s: tṛtīyasya marutvatīyasya grahaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha dīrghavātsyo mukhyenainaṃ pātreṇa gṛhṇīyād iti ||
21.22.109.d: तृतीयस्य मरुत्वतीयस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह दीर्घवात्स्यो मुख्येनैनं पात्रेण गृह्णीयाद् इति ॥
21.22.109.m:
With regard to the drawing of the third Marutvatīya soma-cup:
The sūtra is of the two Teachers.
On this point Dīrghavātsya used to say: "He should draw it with the chief vessel."

21.22.109.s: nārāśam̐sānānām anuprakampana iti || anuprakampayerann iti baudhāyanas |
21.22.109.d: नाराशँसानानाम् अनुप्रकम्पन इति ॥ अनुप्रकम्पयेरन्न् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.22.109.m:
With regard to shaking the nārāśaṃsa cups along [with the chanting]:
"They should shake them along," says Baudhāyana.

21.22.109.s: nānuprakampayerann iti śālīkis | nainān upodyaccheram̐ś canety aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.22.109.d: नानुप्रकम्पयेरन्न् इति शालीकिस् । नैनान् उपोद्यच्छेरँश् चनेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.22.109.m:
"They should not shake them along," says Śālīki.
"They should not even raise them up," says Aupamanyava.

21.22.109.s: saumyasya mantrāmantra iti || mantravān syād iti baudhāyanas
21.22.109.d: सौम्यस्य मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवान् स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
21.22.109.m:
With regard to the presence or absence of mantra for the Saumya cake:
"It should be accompanied by mantra," says Baudhāyana.

21.22.109.s: tūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ saumya eva mantravānt syāt tūṣṇīka ekakapāla ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.22.109.d: तूष्णीक इति शालीकिः सौम्य एव मन्त्रवान्त् स्यात् तूष्णीक एककपाल इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.22.109.m:
"It should be silent," says Śālīki.
"Only the Saumya cake should be accompanied by mantra; the single-potsherd cake should be silent," says Aupamanyava.

21.22.109.s: tārtīyasavanike 'bhiṣava iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yad āpyāyayati tenām̐śumad ity eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.22.109.d: तार्तीयसवनिके ऽभिषव इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यद् आप्याययति तेनाँशुमद् इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.22.109.m:
With regard to the pressing at the third pressing:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"Because he swells it, on that account he should say only: 'Possessed of a stalk,'" says Śālīki.

21.22.110.s: ādityagrahasya grahaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ purastād enam abhiṣavād gṛhṇīyāt tūṣṇīm̐ śṛtātaṅkyam avanayed iti ||
21.22.110.d: आदित्यग्रहस्य ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः पुरस्ताद् एनम् अभिषवाद् गृह्णीयात् तूष्णीँ शृतातङ्क्यम् अवनयेद् इति ॥
21.22.110.m:
With regard to the drawing of the Āditya soma-cup:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.
On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "He should draw it before the pressing; he should pour in the boiled curdling milk silently."

21.22.110.s: ādityagrahasyodāhanana iti || ardharcaśa udāhanyād iti baudhāyanas |
21.22.110.d: आदित्यग्रहस्योदाहनन इति ॥ अर्धर्चश उदाहन्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.22.110.m:
With regard to the raising up of the Āditya soma-cup:
"He should raise it up half-verse by half-verse," says Baudhāyana.

21.22.110.s: maitrāvaruṇasya śrayaṇa āśiro 'vanayana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
21.22.110.d: मैत्रावरुणस्य श्रयण आशिरो ऽवनयन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
21.22.110.m:
With regard to the mixing of the Maitrāvaruṇa soma-cup and the pouring in of the milk-mixture:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.

21.22.110.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ śrīṇīyād eva maitrāvaruṇaṃ payasāśiram avanayed iti ||
21.22.110.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः श्रीणीयाद् एव मैत्रावरुणं पयसाशिरम् अवनयेद् इति ॥
21.22.110.m: On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "He should indeed mix the Maitrāvaruṇa soma-cup; he should pour in the milk-mixture with milk."

With regard to the rule: "When the ninth [verse] has been introduced, he makes him recite":
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.

21.22.110.s: yasyām eva kasyāṃ cid vācayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.22.110.d: यस्याम् एव कस्यां चिद् वाचयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.22.110.m: "He may make him recite at any [verse] whatever," says Śālīki.

21.22.110.s: hotrakāṇām̐ saṃtarpaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'nusavanam eva hotrāḥ saṃtarpayed iti
21.22.110.d: होत्रकाणाँ संतर्पण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽनुसवनम् एव होत्राः संतर्पयेद् इति
21.22.110.m:
With regard to the propitiation of the assistant priests:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.
On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "He should propitiate the hotrā priests at each pressing."

21.22.110.s: pañca prātaḥsavane ṣaṇmādhyaṃdine savane sapta tṛtīyasavana ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.22.110.d: पञ्च प्रातःसवने षण्माध्यंदिने सवने सप्त तृतीयसवन इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.22.110.m: "Five at the morning pressing, six at the midday pressing, seven at the third pressing," says Aupamanyava.

21.22.110.s: aupāsaneṣv iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'nusaṃvrajyaupāsanān anumantrayeta camasebhyaś ca puroḍāśaśakalān upāsyed atra caiva ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyācakṣīteti |
21.22.110.d: औपासनेष्व् इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽनुसंव्रज्यौपासनान् अनुमन्त्रयेत चमसेभ्यश् च पुरोडाशशकलान् उपास्येद् अत्र चैव षड्ढोतारं व्याचक्षीतेति ।
21.22.110.m:
With regard to the aupāsana offerings:
Baudhāyana used to say: "Having stepped along, he should recite over the aupāsana offerings, and he should throw the pieces of sacrificial cake from the soma-goblets, and right here he should explain the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula."

21.22.111.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir anusaṃvrajyaivaupāsanān anumantrayeta pārśvataś camasebhyaḥ puroḍāśaśakalān upāsyed upariṣṭāc ca ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyācakṣīteti ||
21.22.111.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अनुसंव्रज्यैवौपासनान् अनुमन्त्रयेत पार्श्वतश् चमसेभ्यः पुरोडाशशकलान् उपास्येद् उपरिष्टाच् च षड्ढोतारं व्याचक्षीतेति ॥
21.22.111.m: On this point Śālīki used to say: "Having stepped along, he should recite over the aupāsana offerings, he should throw the pieces of sacrificial cake from the soma-goblets from the side, and he should explain the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula afterwards."

21.23.111.s: sāvitrasya grahaṇe sādana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sajuṣṭaṃ parimṛjya sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.23.111.d: सावित्रस्य ग्रहणे सादन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सजुष्टं परिमृज्य सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.23.111.m:
With regard to the drawing and setting down of the Sāvitra soma-cup:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"Having wiped it while still held, he should set it down," says Śālīki.

21.23.111.s: tad anyatomadaṃ pratigṛṇātīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya madā moda iva | ity eva pratigṛṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.23.111.d: तद् अन्यतोमदं प्रतिगृणातीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य मदा मोद इव । इत्य् एव प्रतिगृणीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.23.111.m:
With regard to the rule: "He utters the response with 'madam' on one side":
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"He should utter the response only as 'madā moda iva'," says Śālīki.

21.23.111.s: nārāśam̐sānām anuprakampana iti || anuprakampayerann iti baudhāyanas |
21.23.111.d: नाराशँसानाम् अनुप्रकम्पन इति ॥ अनुप्रकम्पयेरन्न् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.23.111.m:
With regard to shaking the nārāśaṃsa cups along [with the chanting]:
"They should shake them along," says Baudhāyana.

21.23.111.s: nānuprakampayerann iti śālīkis | nainānupodyaccheram̐ś canety aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.23.111.d: नानुप्रकम्पयेरन्न् इति शालीकिस् । नैनानुपोद्यच्छेरँश् चनेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.23.111.m:
"They should not shake them along," says Śālīki.
"They should not even raise them up," says Aupamanyava.

21.23.111.s: saumyasya caryāyā iti || upām̐śu cared iti baudhāyanas |
21.23.111.d: सौम्यस्य चर्याया इति ॥ उपाँशु चरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.23.111.m:
With regard to the performance of the Saumya cake:
"He should perform it in a whisper," says Baudhāyana.

21.23.111.s: saumyasya parījyāyā iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi caiva samastau yadi ca vihṛtāv agnāviṣṇū upām̐śv eva syātām iti
21.23.111.d: सौम्यस्य परीज्याया इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यदि चैव समस्तौ यदि च विहृताव् अग्नाविष्णू उपाँश्व् एव स्याताम् इति
21.23.111.m:
With regard to the subsequent offerings of the Saumya cake:
Baudhāyana used to say: "Whether combined or separated, [the offerings to] Agni-and-Viṣṇu should be in a whisper alone."
"When combined, in a whisper; when separated, aloud," says Śālīki.

21.23.111.s: tārtīyasavanikānāṃ dhiṣṇiyānāṃ viharaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
21.23.111.d: तार्तीयसवनिकानां धिष्णियानां विहरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
21.23.111.m:
With regard to the distribution of the side-hearths belonging to the third pressing:
The sūtra is Śālīki's.

21.23.111.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyanaś caritvā vācaritvā vā saumyenāṅgāraiś caturdhiṣṇiyān vihared iti ||
21.23.111.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनश् चरित्वा वाचरित्वा वा सौम्येनाङ्गारैश् चतुर्धिष्णियान् विहरेद् इति ॥
21.23.111.m: On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "Either after having performed or before having performed [the offering] with the Saumya cake, he should distribute the four side-hearths with burning coals."

21.23.112.s: pātnīvatasya śrayaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya dadhnā vā payasā vā pātnīvatam̐ śrīṇīyād iti śālīkis |
21.23.112.d: पात्नीवतस्य श्रयण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य दध्ना वा पयसा वा पात्नीवतँ श्रीणीयाद् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.23.112.m:
With regard to the mixing of the Pātnīvata soma-cup:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"He should mix the Pātnīvata soma-cup either with curd or with milk," says Śālīki.

21.23.112.s: dhiṣṇiyānāṃ vyāghāraṇaśeṣeṇājyena pātnīvatam̐ śrīṇīyād ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
21.23.112.d: धिष्णियानां व्याघारणशेषेणाज्येन पात्नीवतँ श्रीणीयाद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
21.23.112.m: "He should mix the Pātnīvata soma-cup with the ghee that is the remainder of the sprinkling of the side-hearths," says Aupamanyava.

21.23.112.s: patnyā udānayana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | atraivāsītāpohiṣṭhīyābhya iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.23.112.d: पत्न्या उदानयन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत्रैवासीतापोहिष्ठीयाभ्य इति शालीकिः ॥
21.23.112.m:
With regard to bringing up the wife:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"She should remain right here until the Apohiṣṭhīyā verses," says Śālīki.

With regard to the rule: "He utters the response with 'madam' on both sides":
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.

21.23.112.s: modā moda iva | ity eva pratigṛṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.23.112.d: मोदा मोद इव । इत्य् एव प्रतिगृणीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.23.112.m: "He should utter the response only as 'modā moda iva'," says Śālīki.

21.23.112.s: dhruvasya pracyāvana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sarva evaiṣo 'vanayanamantraḥ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.23.112.d: ध्रुवस्य प्रच्यावन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सर्व एवैषो ऽवनयनमन्त्रः स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.23.112.m:
With regard to moving the Dhruva soma-cup:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
"This entire [formula] should be the pouring-in mantra," says Śālīki.

21.24.112.s: camasānām āyātana iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
21.24.112.d: चमसानाम् आयातन इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
21.24.112.m:
With regard to the arrival of the soma-goblets:
The former procedure is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

21.24.112.s: teṣu trīm̐strīm̐ś ca dūrvāgranthīn prāsyaty ekaikaṃ ca darbhapuñjīlam iti ||
21.24.112.d: तेषु त्रीँस्त्रीँश् च दूर्वाग्रन्थीन् प्रास्यत्य् एकैकं च दर्भपुञ्जीलम् इति ॥
21.24.112.m: With regard to the rule: "Into them he throws three dūrvā grass knots each and a single bunch of darbha grass each":

21.24.112.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | adbhir evaite dakṣāḥ syur iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.24.112.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अद्भिर् एवैते दक्षाः स्युर् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.24.112.m: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "These [soma shoots] should be moistened with water alone," says Śālīki.

21.24.112.s: aupayajeṣv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana āgnīdhrād agnīṣomīyasya ca savanīyasya cāṅgārān āharec chāmitrān maitrāvaruṇyai vaśāyā iti ||
21.24.112.d: औपयजेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन आग्नीध्राद् अग्नीषोमीयस्य च सवनीयस्य चाङ्गारान् आहरेच् छामित्रान् मैत्रावरुण्यै वशाया इति ॥
21.24.112.m: Regarding the supplementary offerings: The sūtra is Śālīki's. On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "He should bring embers from the āgnīdhrīya fire for the victim to Agni and Soma and for the pressing victim, and from the slaughterer's fire for the barren cow to Mitra and Varuṇa."

21.24.113.s: mindāhutyor homa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ purastān mindāhutī juhuyāt |
21.24.113.d: मिन्दाहुत्योर् होम इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः पुरस्तान् मिन्दाहुती जुहुयात् ।
21.24.113.m: Regarding the offering of the two mindā oblations: The sūtra is that of both teachers. On this point Aupamanyava used to say: "He should offer the two mindā oblations beforehand;

21.24.113.s: mindāhutī hutvā hāriyojanaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyād iti ||
21.24.113.d: मिन्दाहुती हुत्वा हारियोजनं ग्रहं गृह्णीयाद् इति ॥
21.24.113.m: having offered the two mindā oblations, he should draw the hāriyojana cup."

21.24.113.s: śākalaiś caryāyā iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yāvanty enām̐si kṛtāny abhivijānīyāt teṣām avayajanam asi | ity abhyādadhyād iti ||
21.24.113.d: शाकलैश् चर्याया इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यावन्त्य् एनाँसि कृतान्य् अभिविजानीयात् तेषाम् अवयजनम् असि । इत्य् अभ्यादध्याद् इति ॥
21.24.113.m: Regarding the procedure with the wood chips: The sūtra is Śālīki's. On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "As many sins as he recognizes to have been committed, [for so many] he should put [chips] on [the fire] with 'You are the expiation thereof.'"

21.24.113.s: ādityasyopasthāna iti || sūraṃ baudhāyanasya | āhavanīyam evaitena yajuṣopatiṣṭherann iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.24.113.d: आदित्यस्योपस्थान इति ॥ सूरं बौधायनस्य । आहवनीयम् एवैतेन यजुषोपतिष्ठेरन्न् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.24.113.m: Regarding the attendance upon the sun: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "They should attend upon the āhavanīya fire itself with this yajus formula," says Śālīki.

21.24.113.s: kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ prāsana iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
21.24.113.d: कृष्णविषाणायाः प्रासन इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
21.24.113.m: Regarding the casting away of the black-antelope horn: The former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

21.24.113.s: avabhṛtha iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo 'traivainam̐ sthaṇḍile kumbhamiśraṃ praropya sthālībhiś ca grāvovāyavyena cāvabhṛtham aveyād iti ||
21.24.113.d: अवभृथ इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो ऽत्रैवैनँ स्थण्डिले कुम्भमिश्रं प्ररोप्य स्थालीभिश् च ग्रावोवायव्येन चावभृथम् अवेयाद् इति ॥
21.24.113.m: Regarding the avabhṛtha bath: The sūtra is that of both teachers. On this point Aupamanyava used to say: "Having planted it mixed with the jar here on a mound, he should go down to the avabhṛtha bath with the pots and with the grāvovāyavya vessel."

21.24.113.s: grāvovāyavyasya praplāvana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya prakṣālyodāhareyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.24.113.d: ग्रावोवायव्यस्य प्रप्लावन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य प्रक्षाल्योदाहरेयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.24.113.m: Regarding the floating of the grāvovāyavya vessel: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "Having washed it, they should bring it back up," says Śālīki.
"Having washed them, they should bring these pots back up;

21.24.113.s: tāsv etāni devikāhavīm̐ṣi śrapayeyur iti baudhāyanaḥ
21.24.113.d: तास्व् एतानि देविकाहवीँषि श्रपयेयुर् इति बौधायनः
21.24.113.m: in them they should cook these devikā oblations," says Baudhāyana;
"They should only float them," says Śālīki.

21.25.113.s: kṛṣṇājinasya praplāvana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ kṛṣṇājinam unmucyādbhir abhyukṣya putrāya vāntevāsine vā dadyāt srucopadhānaṃ vainat kurvīta |
21.25.113.d: कृष्णाजिनस्य प्रप्लावन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः कृष्णाजिनम् उन्मुच्याद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य पुत्राय वान्तेवासिने वा दद्यात् स्रुचोपधानं वैनत् कुर्वीत ।
21.25.113.m: Regarding the floating of the black-antelope skin: The sūtra is Śālīki's. On this point Baudhāyana used to say: "Having taken off the black-antelope skin and sprinkled it with water, he should give it to a son or to a pupil, or he should make it a cushion for the ladles;

21.25.114.m: or he may undergo consecration again with it;
or he may sacrifice again with it."

21.25.114.s: udayanīyasya barhiṣaḥ sam̐skāra iti || asidādānaprabhṛtīn mantrān sādhayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
21.25.114.d: उदयनीयस्य बर्हिषः सँस्कार इति ॥ असिदादानप्रभृतीन् मन्त्रान् साधयेद् इति बौधायनः
21.25.114.m: Regarding the preparation of the sacrificial grass for the concluding rite: "He should carry out the mantras beginning with the taking of the sickle," says Baudhāyana;
"Beginning with the grass cord," says Śālīki;

21.25.114.s: udayanīyasya nirvapaṇa iti || sruci vāvadhāya kṣāmakāṣam̐ sthālyāṃ vā sakṣāmakāṣāyāṃ nirvaped iti ||
21.25.114.d: उदयनीयस्य निर्वपण इति ॥ स्रुचि वावधाय क्षामकाषँ स्थाल्यां वा सक्षामकाषायां निर्वपेद् इति ॥
21.25.114.m: Regarding the pouring out of the concluding oblation: "Either placing it in the ladle, having scraped the residue, or in the pot containing the scraped residue, he should pour it out." —
The former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

21.25.114.s: udayanīyasya śrapaṇa iti || payasi śrapayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.25.114.d: उदयनीयस्य श्रपण इति ॥ पयसि श्रपयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.25.114.m: Regarding the cooking of the concluding oblation: "He should cook it in milk," says Baudhāyana;

21.25.114.s: caror anupariharaṇa iti || anuparihared iti baudhāyanas |
21.25.114.d: चरोर् अनुपरिहरण इति ॥ अनुपरिहरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.25.114.m: Regarding the carrying round of the mess: "He should carry it round," says Baudhāyana;
"He should not carry it round," says Śālīki.
Regarding the setting down of the concluding oblation: "He should set it down with the Six Hotṛs formula," says Baudhāyana;

21.25.114.s: udayanīyasya caryāyā iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āhavanīya evodayanīyena cared iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.25.114.d: उदयनीयस्य चर्याया इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आहवनीय एवोदयनीयेन चरेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.25.114.m: Regarding the performance of the concluding offering: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; one should perform the concluding offering only in the āhavanīya fire, says Śālīki.

21.25.114.s: anūbandhyasya karaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayā yajeteti śālīkis |
21.25.114.d: अनूबन्ध्यस्य करण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य मैत्रावरुण्यामिक्षया यजेतेति शालीकिस् ।
21.25.114.m: Regarding the performance of the anūbandhyā offering: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; one should sacrifice with the curd-and-milk mess to Mitra and Varuṇa, says Śālīki.

21.25.115.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo 'jaṃ paśum apy atrālabheta |
21.25.115.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो ऽजं पशुम् अप्य् अत्रालभेत ।
21.25.115.m: In this matter Aupamanyava used to say: one should also immolate a goat as an animal victim here;

21.25.115.s: ekādaśaparayājaṃ tv eva tantram̐ saṃtiṣṭhāpayiṣed iti ||
21.25.115.d: एकादशपरयाजं त्व् एव तन्त्रँ संतिष्ठापयिषेद् इति ॥
21.25.115.m: and one should seek to establish the procedure with eleven fore-offerings.

21.25.115.s: vapānāṃ parihoma iti || tāṃtāṃ parijuhuyād iti baudhāyanas |
21.25.115.d: वपानां परिहोम इति ॥ तांतां परिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.25.115.m: Regarding the surrounding-offerings of the omenta: one should make surrounding offerings around each and every one, says Baudhāyana;
at the beginning and at the end, says Śālīki.

21.25.115.s: hṛdayaśūlānām udvāsana iti || ekaikaśa udvāsayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
21.25.115.d: हृदयशूलानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ एकैकश उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनः
21.25.115.m: Regarding the disposal of the heart-spits: he should dispose of them one by one, says Baudhāyana;

21.26.115.s: usraṇa iti || sarvān gopaśūn usrayed iti baudhāyanas |
21.26.115.d: उस्रण इति ॥ सर्वान् गोपशून् उस्रयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.26.115.m: Regarding releasing: he should release all bovine victims, says Baudhāyana;
except the bull and the barren cow, says Śālīki.

21.26.115.s: āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti || mantravatī syād iti baudhāyanas
21.26.115.d: आमिक्षायै मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवती स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
21.26.115.m: Regarding the presence or absence of mantras for the curd-and-milk mess: it should be accompanied by mantras, says Baudhāyana;

21.26.115.s: maitrāvaruṇyai paridhiṣv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pūrve sthūṇe sadaso vā havirdhānayor vā bhittvā baidalakān paridhīn maitrāvaruṇyai kuryād iti ||
21.26.115.d: मैत्रावरुण्यै परिधिष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः पूर्वे स्थूणे सदसो वा हविर्धानयोर् वा भित्त्वा बैदलकान् परिधीन् मैत्रावरुण्यै कुर्याद् इति ॥
21.26.115.m: Regarding the enclosing sticks for the victim to Mitra and Varuṇa: the sūtra is Śālīki's; in this matter Baudhāyana used to say: having cleaved the two eastern posts either of the sadas or of the havirdhāna shed, he should make split-bamboo enclosing sticks for the victim to Mitra and Varuṇa.

21.26.116.s: udavasāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pūrṇāhutyaivodavasyed iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.26.116.d: उदवसान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पूर्णाहुत्यैवोदवस्येद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.26.116.m: Regarding the rising: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; one should rise only after the full-spoon libation, says Śālīki.

21.26.116.s: dakṣiṇāyai dāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nātrākāmaniyataṃ deyam iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.26.116.d: दक्षिणायै दान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नात्राकामनियतं देयम् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.26.116.m: Regarding the giving of the sacrificial fee: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; nothing should be given here beyond what is desired, says Śālīki.

21.26.116.s: devikāhaviṣāṃ karaṇa iti || sūtram aupamanyavīputrasya | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas trīṇy anūbandhyasya paśupuroḍāśam anuvarteram̐s trīṇy udavasānīyām iti
21.26.116.d: देविकाहविषां करण इति ॥ सूत्रम् औपमन्यवीपुत्रस्य । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् त्रीण्य् अनूबन्ध्यस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुवर्तेरँस् त्रीण्य् उदवसानीयाम् इति
21.26.116.m: Regarding the preparation of the devikā oblations: the sūtra is Aupamanyavīputra's; in this matter Baudhāyana used to say: three should follow the animal cake of the anūbandhyā, and three the rising offering;

21.26.116.s: sarvāṇy evānūbandhyasya paśupuroḍāśam anuvarterann iti śālīkis |
21.26.116.d: सर्वाण्य् एवानूबन्ध्यस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुवर्तेरन्न् इति शालीकिस् ।
21.26.116.m: all of them should follow the animal cake of the anūbandhyā, says Śālīki;
he should sacrifice to the devikās with clarified butter alone, says Āñjīgavi.

21.26.116.s: agnibhiḥ pratyavasāna iti || ajasraiḥ pratyavasyed iti baudhāyanas |
21.26.116.d: अग्निभिः प्रत्यवसान इति ॥ अजस्रैः प्रत्यवस्येद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.26.116.m: Regarding descending again with the fires: he should descend with uninterrupted fires, says Baudhāyana;
having mounted them into the two churning-sticks, says Śālīki.

21.26.116.s: agnihotrayoḥ pratihomaḥ iti || pratijuhuyād iti baudhāyanas |
21.26.116.d: अग्निहोत्रयोः प्रतिहोमः इति ॥ प्रतिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
21.26.116.m: Regarding the counter-libation of the two agnihotras: he should offer the counter-libation, says Baudhāyana;

21.26.116.s: na pratijuhuyād iti śālīkir na pratijuhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
21.26.116.d: न प्रतिजुहुयाद् इति शालीकिर् न प्रतिजुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
21.26.116.m: he should not offer the counter-libation, says Śālīki; he should not offer the counter-libation, says Śālīki.

22.1.117.m: Now then we shall explain the ritual of the fire altar.

22.1.117.s: kharasya karaṇa iti || uttarapūrve 'vāntaradeśe kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
22.1.117.d: खरस्य करण इति ॥ उत्तरपूर्वे ऽवान्तरदेशे कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.1.117.m: Regarding the preparation of the mound: he should make it in the intermediate north-eastern quarter, says Baudhāyana;

22.1.117.s: sāvitrāṇām̐ homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya samṛddhyāpy atra caturgṛhītaṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.1.117.d: सावित्राणाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य समृद्ध्याप्य् अत्र चतुर्गृहीतं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.1.117.m: Regarding the offering of the sāvitra libations: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; for success, here too he should offer four ladlings, says Śālīki.
Regarding taking the donkey's halter: he should take it with a mantra, says Baudhāyana;

22.1.117.s: valmīkavapāyai nidhāne vaiśyasyopaveśana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
22.1.117.d: वल्मीकवपायै निधाने वैश्यस्योपवेशन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
22.1.117.m: Regarding placing the anthill core and seating a vaiśya: the sūtra is Śālīki's;

22.1.117.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyano valmīkavapāṃ nidadhyān na vaiśyam upaveśayed yatra khaniḥ syāt tad gacched yas tatra pṛcchet taṃ pratibrūyād iti ||
22.1.117.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो वल्मीकवपां निदध्यान् न वैश्यम् उपवेशयेद् यत्र खनिः स्यात् तद् गच्छेद् यस् तत्र पृच्छेत् तं प्रतिब्रूयाद् इति ॥
22.1.117.m: in this matter Baudhāyana used to say: he should place the anthill core, but he should not seat a vaiśya; he should go to where the excavation is, and whoever asks there, to him he should answer.

22.1.117.s: khanana iti || ardharcaśaḥ khaned iti baudhāyanas | ṛcarceti śālīkiḥ ||
22.1.117.d: खनन इति ॥ अर्धर्चशः खनेद् इति बौधायनस् । ऋचर्चेति शालीकिः ॥
22.1.117.m: Regarding the digging: he should dig verse-half by verse-half, says Baudhāyana; verse by verse, says Śālīki.
Regarding spreading a lotus leaf with its stem pointing to the north: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's;
he should spread it just as it was produced, says Śālīki.

22.1.117.s: piṇḍānām̐ haraṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarvābhiḥsarvābhiś caturhared iti
22.1.117.d: पिण्डानाँ हरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः सर्वाभिःसर्वाभिश् चतुर्हरेद् इति
22.1.117.m: Regarding taking the lumps of clay: the sūtra is Śālīki's; in this matter Baudhāyana used to say: he should take four times with all the verses;

22.1.117.s: gāyatrībhir haret triṣṭugbhiḥ sādayed ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.1.117.d: गायत्रीभिर् हरेत् त्रिष्टुग्भिः सादयेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.1.117.m: he should take with the gāyatrī verses and set them down with the triṣṭubh verses, says Aupamanyava.

22.1.117.s: aśvasyātyāyamana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas tūṣṇīm aśvamatyāyacchet
22.1.117.d: अश्वस्यात्यायमन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् तूष्णीम् अश्वमत्यायच्छेत्
22.1.117.m: Regarding leading the horse past: the sūtra is Śālīki's; in this matter Baudhāyana used to say: he should lead the horse past silently;
this whole formula should be a donkey-mantra.

22.1.118.s: dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ samīkṣaṇa iti || ubhe ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ samīkṣeteti baudhāyanas
22.1.118.d: द्यावापृथिव्योः समीक्षण इति ॥ उभे षट्कृत्वः समीक्षेतेति बौधायनस्
22.1.118.m: Regarding looking at heaven and earth: he should look at both six times, says Baudhāyana;

22.1.118.s: trir eveti śālīkiḥ prācyāṃ diśi saṃdhim īkṣamāṇa etaṃ mantraṃ japed ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.1.118.d: त्रिर् एवेति शालीकिः प्राच्यां दिशि संधिम् ईक्षमाण एतं मन्त्रं जपेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.1.118.m: only three times, says Śālīki; looking at the junction in the eastern direction, he should mutter this mantra, says Aupamanyava.

22.1.118.s: apo raśane abhyavaharantyapi vādbhir abhyukṣya bhuñjata iti ||
22.1.118.d: अपो रशने अभ्यवहरन्त्यपि वाद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य भुञ्जत इति ॥
22.1.118.m: Regarding whether they carry down the two halters to water or use them having sprinkled them with water:
the former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.2.118.s: ukhānāṃ karaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'ṣāḍhām apy etasyai yājuṣyai pādamātrīṃ kuryād yāvan mātrīṃ cādayeṣṭakām ṛttikāyām apisṛjet |
22.2.118.d: उखानां करण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽषाढाम् अप्य् एतस्यै याजुष्यै पादमात्रीं कुर्याद् यावन् मात्रीं चादयेष्टकाम् ऋत्तिकायाम् अपिसृजेत् ।
22.2.118.m: Regarding making the fire-pots: Baudhāyana used to say: he should make even the unconquerable brick of a foot's size out of this ritual clay, and whatever size first brick he mixes in the clay;

22.2.118.s: evam asya sarvo 'gnir yājuṣo bhavatīti | ekām evokhāṃ mantreṇa kuryāt tūṣṇīm itare iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.118.d: एवम् अस्य सर्वो ऽग्निर् याजुषो भवतीति । एकाम् एवोखां मन्त्रेण कुर्यात् तूष्णीम् इतरे इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.118.m: thus his entire fire altar becomes invested with mantras; he should make only one fire-pot with a mantra, the other two silently, says Śālīki.

22.2.118.s: sarvāsu bhinnāsu pratyaya iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sasāvitraṃ mantrakarmābhyāvartayed iti ||
22.2.118.d: सर्वासु भिन्नासु प्रत्यय इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः ससावित्रं मन्त्रकर्माभ्यावर्तयेद् इति ॥
22.2.118.m: Regarding the repetition when all have broken: Baudhāyana used to say: he should repeat the action accompanied by mantras along with the sāvitra libations;
whatever is other than the sāvitra libations, says Śālīki.

22.2.118.s: athādatta ekavim̐śatiṃ vṛṣṇo aśvasya śakṛtpiṇḍān abhrim agniṃ pacanam iti ||
22.2.118.d: अथादत्त एकविँशतिं वृष्णो अश्वस्य शकृत्पिण्डान् अभ्रिम् अग्निं पचनम् इति ॥
22.2.118.m: Regarding the passage: 'Now he takes twenty-one dung-balls of a stallion, a spade, fire, and the cooking-fuel':

22.2.118.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yasyaiva kasya cāśvasyādadīteti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.118.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यस्यैव कस्य चाश्वस्याददीतेति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.118.m: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; he should take of whatever horse it may be, says Śālīki.

22.2.118.s: ukhānāṃ dhūpana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | aparimitair mantrair dhūpayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.118.d: उखानां धूपन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अपरिमितैर् मन्त्रैर् धूपयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.118.m: Regarding fumigating the fire-pots: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; he should fumigate with an unlimited number of mantras, says Śālīki.

22.2.119.s: ukhānāṃ pravṛñjana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ekām evokhāṃ mantreṇa pravṛñjyāt tūṣṇīm itare iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.119.d: उखानां प्रवृञ्जन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । एकाम् एवोखां मन्त्रेण प्रवृञ्ज्यात् तूष्णीम् इतरे इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.119.m: Regarding placing the fire-pots on the fire: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's; he should place only one fire-pot on the fire with a mantra, the other two silently, says Śālīki.

22.2.119.s: tāḥ prācīr vodīcīr vāyātayatīti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.2.119.d: ताः प्राचीर् वोदीचीर् वायातयतीति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.2.119.m: Regarding whether he arranges them facing east or facing north: the former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.2.119.s: pacana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ukhā ṛṣabhān maṇḍaleṣṭakā bārhaspatyaṃ mahāvīraṃ lokaṃpṛṇā ity etad gārhapatyāt pacet |
22.2.119.d: पचन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उखा ऋषभान् मण्डलेष्टका बार्हस्पत्यं महावीरं लोकंपृणा इत्य् एतद् गार्हपत्यात् पचेत् ।
22.2.119.m: Regarding the baking: Baudhāyana used to say: the fire-pots, the bulls, the circular bricks, the Bārhaspatya brick, the mahāvīra pot, and the space-filler bricks—these he should bake from the gārhapatya fire;

22.2.119.s: athetarad grāmāgner iti yat kiṃ ceṣṭakoktaṃ grāmāgninā tat paced dhaviruktaṃ gārhapatyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.119.d: अथेतरद् ग्रामाग्नेर् इति यत् किं चेष्टकोक्तं ग्रामाग्निना तत् पचेद् धविरुक्तं गार्हपत्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.119.m: and the other from village fire; Śālīki says: whatever is designated as a brick, that he should bake with village fire; what is designated as oblation, from the gārhapatya fire.

22.2.119.s: paśuśīrṣāṇāṃ karaṇa iti || pratyakṣāṇi vā mārttikāni vā syur iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.2.119.d: पशुशीर्षाणां करण इति ॥ प्रत्यक्षाणि वा मार्त्तिकानि वा स्युर् इति बौधायनः
22.2.119.m: Regarding making the heads of the victims: they should be either real or made of clay, says Baudhāyana;
they should be real only, says Śālīki; made of gold, says Aupamanyava;

22.2.119.s: vāyavyaśirasi vaitān mantrān nigaded ity aupamanyavīputraḥ ||
22.2.119.d: वायव्यशिरसि वैतान् मन्त्रान् निगदेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रः ॥
22.2.119.m: or he should recite these mantras over the head of the victim to Vāyu, says Aupamanyavīputra.

22.2.119.s: trir apasalaiḥ parṇaśākhayā parikarṣatīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
22.2.119.d: त्रिर् अपसलैः पर्णशाखया परिकर्षतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
22.2.119.m: Regarding dragging around three times counter-clockwise with a palāśa branch: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's;

22.2.119.s: anuparikīryaiva māṣān yamagāthābhiḥ parigāyed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.119.d: अनुपरिकीर्यैव माषान् यमगाथाभिः परिगायेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.119.m: having scattered kidney-beans around, he should sing around with the verses to Yama, says Śālīki.

22.2.119.s: āghāra iti || ubhābhyāṃ mantrābhyām etam āghāram āghārayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.2.119.d: आघार इति ॥ उभाभ्यां मन्त्राभ्याम् एतम् आघारम् आघारयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.2.119.m: Regarding the continuous pour of butter: he should pour this continuous stream with both mantras, says Baudhāyana;

22.2.119.s: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre | ity etayaivaitam āghāram āghārayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.2.119.d: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे । इत्य् एतयैवैतम् आघारम् आघारयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.2.119.m: with only this verse: 'The Golden Embryo evolved at first', should he pour this continuous stream, says Śālīki.

22.3.119.m: Regarding the offering of the initiation libations for the somayāga for one who has not offered his first soma sacrifice:

22.3.119.s: adhvaradīkṣāhutīr hutvāgnikā juhuyād iti baudhāyanas | āgnikā eveti śālīkiḥ ||
22.3.119.d: अध्वरदीक्षाहुतीर् हुत्वाग्निका जुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् । आग्निका एवेति शालीकिः ॥
22.3.119.m: "Having offered the consecration offerings for the soma sacrifice, he should offer the fire-related ones," says Baudhāyana. "Only the fire-related ones," says Śālīki.

22.3.119.s: vairājīṣu dīkṣāsv iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano nāsaṃvatsaram̐ soṣyan vairājīr dīkṣāḥ kurvīta
22.3.119.d: वैराजीषु दीक्षास्व् इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो नासंवत्सरँ सोष्यन् वैराजीर् दीक्षाः कुर्वीत
22.3.119.m: Regarding the vairāja consecrations: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "One who is not going to press soma for a year should not undertake the vairāja consecrations.

22.3.120.s: kāmam̐ saṃvatsaram̐ soṣyan vairājīr dīkṣāḥ kurvīta
22.3.120.d: कामँ संवत्सरँ सोष्यन् वैराजीर् दीक्षाः कुर्वीत
22.3.120.m: At will, one who is going to press soma for a year may undertake the vairāja consecrations.

22.3.120.s: saṃvatsaraṃ vā bhṛtvaikāhikaṃ kurvītaikāhikas tv evāgnir iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.3.120.d: संवत्सरं वा भृत्वैकाहिकं कुर्वीतैकाहिकस् त्व् एवाग्निर् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.3.120.m: Or having carried [the fire in the pot] for a year, one should perform a one-day sacrifice; but the fire is indeed only of a one-day ritual," says Śālīki.

22.3.120.s: kāmyasyānvavadhāna iti || jāte kāmyam anvavadadhyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.3.120.d: काम्यस्यान्ववधान इति ॥ जाते काम्यम् अन्ववदध्याद् इति बौधायनः
22.3.120.m: Regarding the subsequent placing of optional items: "When [the fire] is produced, he should place the optional item subsequently," says Baudhāyana.

22.3.120.s: audumbarīṇām̐ samidhām abhyādhāna iti || sūtraṃ śālīkes |
22.3.120.d: औदुम्बरीणाँ समिधाम् अभ्याधान इति ॥ सूत्रं शालीकेस् ।
22.3.120.m: Regarding the putting on of the kindling-sticks of udumbara wood: the sutra is Śālīki's.

22.3.120.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyana ekām eva samidhaṃ pañcarcenābhyādadhyāt
22.3.120.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन एकाम् एव समिधं पञ्चर्चेनाभ्यादध्यात्
22.3.120.m: Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "He should put on only a single kindling-stick with the five-verse hymn.
That alone should be the demon-slaying rite."

22.3.120.d: अन्नपतीयायै समिधो ऽभ्याधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
22.3.120.m: Regarding the putting on of the Annapatīyā kindling-stick: the sutra is Śālīki's.

22.3.120.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'nnapatīyāṃ pratisamedhanīyāṃ vaiṣṇavīm ity etā abhyādadhyād iti ||
22.3.120.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽन्नपतीयां प्रतिसमेधनीयां वैष्णवीम् इत्य् एता अभ्यादध्याद् इति ॥
22.3.120.m: Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "He should put on these: the Annapatīyā, the Pratisamedhanīyā, and the Vaiṣṇavī."

22.3.120.s: vātsapraviṣṇukramayoḥ saṃnipāta iti || aharahaḥ saṃnipātayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.3.120.d: वात्सप्रविष्णुक्रमयोः संनिपात इति ॥ अहरहः संनिपातयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.3.120.m: Regarding the combination of the Vātsapra [hymn] and the Viṣṇukrama [steps]: "He should combine them day by day," says Baudhāyana.
"At the beginning and at the end," says Śālīki.

22.3.120.s: ukhya udvāte prāyaścittakaraṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pravṛjya paridāyārkāhutibhir abhijuhuyād athetarat karmāvṛtā kuryād iti |
22.3.120.d: उख्य उद्वाते प्रायश्चित्तकरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रवृज्य परिदायार्काहुतिभिर् अभिजुहुयाद् अथेतरत् कर्मावृता कुर्याद् इति ।
22.3.120.m: Regarding the performance of the expiation when the fire in the pot is extinguished: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "Having set it aside and handed it over, he should make offerings with the Arkāhuti formulas; then he should perform the other rite in ordinary fashion."

22.3.121.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ pravṛjya paridāyārkāhutibhir abhijuhuyān na cetarat karmāvṛtā kuryād iti ||
22.3.121.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः प्रवृज्य परिदायार्काहुतिभिर् अभिजुहुयान् न चेतरत् कर्मावृता कुर्याद् इति ॥
22.3.121.m: Here Śālīki indeed used to say: "Having set it aside and handed it over, he should make offerings with the Arkāhuti formulas; he should not perform the other rite in ordinary fashion."

22.3.121.s: prayāṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayena prayāyād ādhvarikeṇa cāgnikena ceti |
22.3.121.d: प्रयाण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उभयेन प्रयायाद् आध्वरिकेण चाग्निकेन चेति ।
22.3.121.m: Regarding the setting out: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "He should set out with both: the one belonging to the soma sacrifice and the one belonging to the fire ritual."
"Only with the one belonging to the fire ritual," says Śālīki.

22.3.121.s: atha yady aparyāṇā apa upādhigacchatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
22.3.121.d: अथ यद्य् अपर्याणा अप उपाधिगच्छतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
22.3.121.m: "Now, if he comes upon non-flowing waters": the sutra is Śālīki's.

22.3.121.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyano yatraivāparyāṇā apa upādhigacchet tad bhasma praveśayen na ca vigarbhāṃ tāṃ kuryād yāvan mātraṃ cādāya pratyavadadhyāt prasadya bhasmanā yonim ity athetarat sthālīṣu vā sateṣu vānunidhāpayed iti ||
22.3.121.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यत्रैवापर्याणा अप उपाधिगच्छेत् तद् भस्म प्रवेशयेन् न च विगर्भां तां कुर्याद् यावन् मात्रं चादाय प्रत्यवदध्यात् प्रसद्य भस्मना योनिम् इत्य् अथेतरत् स्थालीषु वा सतेषु वानुनिधापयेद् इति ॥
22.3.121.m: Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "Right where he comes upon non-flowing waters, there he should cause the ashes to enter [the waters], and he should not make that [pot] void of womb; taking as much [ash] as required, he should put it back with 'Having sat down in the womb with the ash...'; then he should cause the remainder to be placed down in pots or in flat dishes."

22.3.121.s: devayajanasyādhyavasāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayenādhyavasyed ādhvarikeṇa cāgnikena ceti |
22.3.121.d: देवयजनस्याध्यवसान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उभयेनाध्यवस्येद् आध्वरिकेण चाग्निकेन चेति ।
22.3.121.m: Regarding the taking possession of the place of sacrifice: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "He should take possession with both: that belonging to the soma sacrifice and that belonging to the fire ritual."
"Only with that belonging to the fire ritual," says Śālīki.

22.4.121.s: saṃbhārāṇāṃ nivapana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano bhasma caivoṣām̐ś ca mantreṇa nivapet
22.4.121.d: संभाराणां निवपन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो भस्म चैवोषाँश् च मन्त्रेण निवपेत्
22.4.121.m: Regarding the pouring out of the ritual materials: the sutra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "He should pour out the ashes and the saline soil with a formula;
the other two ritual materials silently."

22.4.121.s: gārhapatyacitāv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'gnigrahaṇam̐ svayaṃcitim̐ śvetakṛṣṇayor abhimarśanam adhidravaṇam avadravaṇam iti sarvam evaitat karmāvṛtā kuryād iti ||
22.4.121.d: गार्हपत्यचिताव् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽग्निग्रहणँ स्वयंचितिँ श्वेतकृष्णयोर् अभिमर्शनम् अधिद्रवणम् अवद्रवणम् इति सर्वम् एवैतत् कर्मावृता कुर्याद् इति ॥
22.4.121.m: Regarding the piling of the gārhapatya [hearth]: the sutra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "The taking of the fire, the self-piling, the touching of the white and black [horses], the running over, and the running down—he should perform all this rite in ordinary fashion."

22.4.122.s: sāhasraṃ cinvīta prathamaṃ cinvānaḥ pañcacitīkaṃ ceti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ samāpyaitāś caturthaṃ cinvāno jānudaghnaṃ cāta ūrdhvaṃ pratyādadīta pañcacitīkaṃ ceti |
22.4.122.d: साहस्रं चिन्वीत प्रथमं चिन्वानः पञ्चचितीकं चेति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः समाप्यैताश् चतुर्थं चिन्वानो जानुदघ्नं चात ऊर्ध्वं प्रत्याददीत पञ्चचितीकं चेति ।
22.4.122.m: Regarding: "One piling [the fire altar] for the first time should pile a thousand [bricks] and five layers": Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "Having completed these, one piling for the fourth time should henceforth resume [piling] knee-high and five layers."

22.4.122.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ samāpyaitāś caturthaṃ cinvāno grīvadaghnaṃ caivāta ūrdhvaṃ pratyādadītaikacitīkaṃ ceti ||
22.4.122.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः समाप्यैताश् चतुर्थं चिन्वानो ग्रीवदघ्नं चैवात ऊर्ध्वं प्रत्याददीतैकचितीकं चेति ॥
22.4.122.m: Here Śālīki indeed used to say: "Having completed these, one piling for the fourth time should henceforth resume [piling] neck-high and with a single layer."

22.4.122.s: vātsapraviṣṇukramayoḥ saṃnipāta iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yady u ha vātsapramupavasathe saṃpadyeta vātsapreṇopasthāya saṃnivapeta |
22.4.122.d: वात्सप्रविष्णुक्रमयोः संनिपात इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यद्य् उ ह वात्सप्रमुपवसथे संपद्येत वात्सप्रेणोपस्थाय संनिवपेत ।
22.4.122.m: Regarding the combination of the Vātsapra [hymn] and the Viṣṇukrama [steps]: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "If the Vātsapra should fall due on the fast-day, having attended [the fire] with the Vātsapra, he should pour [the ashes] together.

22.4.122.s: atha yadi viṣṇukramā upavasathe saṃpadyeran viṣṇukramaiḥ kramitvā vātsapreṇopasthāya saṃnivāpena prakrāmed iti |
22.4.122.d: अथ यदि विष्णुक्रमा उपवसथे संपद्येरन् विष्णुक्रमैः क्रमित्वा वात्सप्रेणोपस्थाय संनिवापेन प्रक्रामेद् इति ।
22.4.122.m: Now, if the Viṣṇukrama [steps] should fall due on the fast-day, having stepped with the Viṣṇukrama steps and attended [the fire] with the Vātsapra, he should proceed with the pouring together."

22.4.122.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir yady u ha vātsapramupavasathe saṃpadyeta vātsapreṇopasthāya śvo bhūte saṃnivapeta |
22.4.122.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् यद्य् उ ह वात्सप्रमुपवसथे संपद्येत वात्सप्रेणोपस्थाय श्वो भूते संनिवपेत ।
22.4.122.m: Here Śālīki indeed used to say: "If the Vātsapra should fall due on the fast-day, having attended [the fire] with the Vātsapra, he should pour [the ashes] together on the next morning.

22.4.122.s: atha yadi viṣṇukramā upavasathe saṃpadyeran viṣṇukramaiḥ kramitvā vātsapreṇopasthāya śvo bhūte saṃnivāpenaiva prakrāmed iti ||
22.4.122.d: अथ यदि विष्णुक्रमा उपवसथे संपद्येरन् विष्णुक्रमैः क्रमित्वा वात्सप्रेणोपस्थाय श्वो भूते संनिवापेनैव प्रक्रामेद् इति ॥
22.4.122.m: Now, if the Viṣṇukrama [steps] should fall due on the fast-day, having stepped with the Viṣṇukrama steps and attended [the fire] with the Vātsapra, he should proceed with the pouring together only on the next morning."

22.4.122.s: tasyām anyatrāvekṣamāṇo dadhidrapsān prāsyati | amuṃ te śuci dadhāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
22.4.122.d: तस्याम् अन्यत्रावेक्षमाणो दधिद्रप्सान् प्रास्यति । अमुं ते शुचि दधामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
22.4.122.m: Looking elsewhere, he throws drops of curd into it, either with 'I place this pure thing in you' or silently.
