The former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.
Regarding: "Then, having filled it with sand and covered it over with curd":

22.4.122.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sikatābhir evaināṃ pūrayitvottare śālākhaṇḍe nidadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.4.122.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सिकताभिर् एवैनां पूरयित्वोत्तरे शालाखण्डे निदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.4.122.m: the sutra is Baudhāyana's. "Having filled it with sand alone, he should deposit it in the northern part of the hall," says Śālīki.

22.4.123.s: śikyasyādāna iti || mantreṇādadīteti baudhāyanas tūṣṇīm iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.4.123.d: शिक्यस्यादान इति ॥ मन्त्रेणाददीतेति बौधायनस् तूष्णीम् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.4.123.m: Regarding the taking up of the sling: "He should take it up with a formula," says Baudhāyana; "Silently," says Śālīki.

22.4.123.s: nairṛtīnām upasthāna iti || kurvītātra tayādevatasūdadohase iti baudhāyanas |
22.4.123.d: नैरृतीनाम् उपस्थान इति ॥ कुर्वीतात्र तयादेवतसूददोहसे इति बौधायनस् ।
22.4.123.m: Regarding the attending of the Nairṛta bricks: "Here he should perform the Tayādevatā and Sūdadohas formulas," says Baudhāyana.

22.4.123.s: udapātrasyopaninayana iti || pradakṣiṇam upaninayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.4.123.d: उदपात्रस्योपनिनयन इति ॥ प्रदक्षिणम् उपनिनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.4.123.m: Regarding the pouring out of the water vessel: "He should pour it out sunwise," says Baudhāyana.
"As it happens to come," says Śālīki.

22.4.123.s: gārhapatyasyopasthāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āhavanīyam evaitena yajuṣopatiṣṭherann iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.4.123.d: गार्हपत्यस्योपस्थान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आहवनीयम् एवैतेन यजुषोपतिष्ठेरन्न् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.4.123.m: Regarding the attending of the gārhapatya [fire]: the sutra is Baudhāyana's. "They should attend the āhavanīya fire itself with this formula," says Śālīki.

22.5.123.s: stambayajuṣo haraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | uparavakālād apy atrāgnīdhro hared iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.5.123.d: स्तम्बयजुषो हरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । उपरवकालाद् अप्य् अत्राग्नीध्रो हरेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.5.123.m: Regarding the carrying of the grass-bush formula [and earth]: the sutra is Baudhāyana's. "Even from the time of the sounding-holes, the āgnīdhra priest should carry [it] here," says Śālīki.
The drawing of the line around the pit has been explained.
The carrying of the common fires has been explained.
The attending of the wooden swords and mallets has been explained.

22.5.123.s: kārṣṇājinīnām upamocana iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.5.123.d: कार्ष्णाजिनीनाम् उपमोचन इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.5.123.m: Regarding the fastening of the black-antelope skin shoes: the former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

22.5.123.s: vajriṇīnām upadhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'greṇa yūpāvaṭīyam̐ śaṅkuṃ tiṣṭhan dhanur adhijyaṃ kṛtvā prāñcaṃ bāṇaṃ pravidhyet
22.5.123.d: वज्रिणीनाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽग्रेण यूपावटीयँ शङ्कुं तिष्ठन् धनुर् अधिज्यं कृत्वा प्राञ्चं बाणं प्रविध्येत्
22.5.123.m: Regarding the laying down of the Vajriṇī bricks: the sutra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: "Standing in front of the stake for the sacrificial post, having strung the bow, he should shoot an arrow towards the east.

22.5.123.s: tam anudrutyāśmānam upadadhyāt | evaṃ dakṣiṇata eva paścād evam uttarata iti ||
22.5.123.d: तम् अनुद्रुत्याश्मानम् उपदध्यात् । एवं दक्षिणत एव पश्चाद् एवम् उत्तरत इति ॥
22.5.123.m: Running after it, he should place a stone [there]. In this manner to the south, thus to the west, thus to the north."

22.5.124.s: aindriyā upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya puccha aindrīm upadadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.5.124.d: ऐन्द्रिया उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पुच्छ ऐन्द्रीम् उपदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.5.124.m: Regarding the laying down of the Aindrī brick: the sutra is Baudhāyana's. "He should lay down the Aindrī brick at the tail," says Śālīki.

22.5.124.s: upapātrasyopaninaya iti | pradakṣiṇam upaninayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.5.124.d: उपपात्रस्योपनिनय इति । प्रदक्षिणम् उपनिनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.5.124.m: Regarding the pouring out of the water vessel: "He should pour it out sunwise," says Baudhāyana.
"As it happens to come," says Śālīki.

22.5.124.s: darbhastambasyopadhāna iti || vāk tvā samudra upadadhātu | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
22.5.124.d: दर्भस्तम्बस्योपधान इति ॥ वाक् त्वा समुद्र उपदधातु । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
22.5.124.m: Regarding the placing of the clump of darbha grass: either with 'May speech, the ocean, place you' or silently.
The former view is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

22.5.124.s: dūrveṣṭakāyā upadhāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano dūrvayā vā sahopadadhyād dūrvāṃ vaiveti
22.5.124.d: दूर्वेष्टकाया उपधान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो दूर्वया वा सहोपदध्याद् दूर्वां वैवेति
22.5.124.m: Regarding the laying down of the Dūrvā brick: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, "He should either lay it down together with dūrvā grass, or [lay down] dūrvā grass alone."
"This should be only the dūrvā grass accompanied by formulas," says Śālīki.

22.5.124.s: audumbaraṃ yugalāṅgalam iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya dārḍhyavṛkṣam evainat kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.5.124.d: औदुम्बरं युगलाङ्गलम् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य दार्ढ्यवृक्षम् एवैनत् कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.5.124.m: Regarding: "A yoke and plough of udumbara wood": the sutra is Baudhāyana's. "He should make it only of a strong wood," says Śālīki.

22.5.124.s: puruṣā evaitad yugalāṅgalaṃ purastād ādadate 'dhvaryuḥ paścād iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.5.124.d: पुरुषा एवैतद् युगलाङ्गलं पुरस्ताद् आददते ऽध्वर्युः पश्चाद् इति बौधायनः
22.5.124.m: "Men themselves take this yoke and plough in front, and the adhvaryu priest behind," says Baudhāyana.

22.5.124.s: pratyakṣam evaitat saṃyujya kṛṣed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.5.124.d: प्रत्यक्षम् एवैतत् संयुज्य कृषेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.5.124.m: "Having hitched it right visibly, he should plough," says Śālīki.

22.5.124.s: karṣaṇa iti || saṃpratyāhāraṃ kṛṣed iti baudhāyanas | āvājaśa iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.5.124.d: कर्षण इति ॥ संप्रत्याहारं कृषेद् इति बौधायनस् । आवाजश इति शालीकिः ॥
22.5.124.m: As to plowing: Baudhāyana says he should plow with repeated drawing back; Śālīki says [he should plow] continuously.

22.6.125.s: goyugānām anumantraṇa iti || tattad evānumantrayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.6.125.d: गोयुगानाम् अनुमन्त्रण इति ॥ तत्तद् एवानुमन्त्रयेद् इति बौधायनः
22.6.125.m: As to the address to the pairs of oxen: Baudhāyana says he should address each one individually;
Śālīki says [he should address] all of them together.

22.6.125.s: sarvauṣadhasya vapana iti || ardharcaśo vaped iti baudhāyanas |
22.6.125.d: सर्वौषधस्य वपन इति ॥ अर्धर्चशो वपेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.6.125.m: As to the sowing of all [kinds of] herbs: Baudhāyana says he should sow by half-verses;

22.6.125.s: itaram itaratra vipariharatītaram itaratreti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
22.6.125.d: इतरम् इतरत्र विपरिहरतीतरम् इतरत्रेति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
22.6.125.m: As to [the passage]: "He exchanges the other in the other place, the other in the other place": the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana;

22.6.125.s: ādadāna evaitāṃ diśam abhisaṃpādayed iti śālīkis | yajuṣā yajur viparihared ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.6.125.d: आददान एवैतां दिशम् अभिसंपादयेद् इति शालीकिस् । यजुषा यजुर् विपरिहरेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.6.125.m: Śālīki says while taking [it] he should face this direction; Aupamanyava says he should exchange yajus for yajus.

22.6.125.s: sa darbhapuñjīlāni payaḥprokṣe 'vadhāya taiḥ prokṣati | agnīn vo 'gnibhyo juṣṭān prokṣāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
22.6.125.d: स दर्भपुञ्जीलानि पयःप्रोक्षे ऽवधाय तैः प्रोक्षति । अग्नीन् वो ऽग्निभ्यो जुष्टान् प्रोक्षामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
22.6.125.m: As to [the question]: "Having put darbha tufts into the milk-sprinkling, he sprinkles them with [the formula]: 'O fires, I sprinkle you agreeable to the fires', or silently?"
The former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.6.125.s: kumbheṣṭakānām upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pakṣapuccheṣv evainā upadadhyād iti baudhāyaniḥ ||
22.6.125.d: कुम्भेष्टकानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पक्षपुच्छेष्व् एवैना उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनिः ॥
22.6.125.m: As to the placing of the jar-bricks: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Baudhāyani says he should place them only on the wings and the tail.

22.6.125.s: nānāmantrāsu diśo bhajamānāsv iti || tayādevatenānukramya pāre sūdadohasaḥ kurvīteti baudhāyanas
22.6.125.d: नानामन्त्रासु दिशो भजमानास्व् इति ॥ तयादेवतेनानुक्रम्य पारे सूददोहसः कुर्वीतेति बौधायनस्
22.6.125.m: As to [the bricks] sharing the quarters with different mantras: Baudhāyana says, having gone through them with the tayādevatā formula, he should perform the sūdadohas verses at the end;
Śālīki says he should complete each brick [individually].

22.6.125.s: iṣṭakāgaṇānām upadhāna iti || tayādevatenānukramya pāre sūdadohasaḥ kurvīteti baudhāyanas
22.6.125.d: इष्टकागणानाम् उपधान इति ॥ तयादेवतेनानुक्रम्य पारे सूददोहसः कुर्वीतेति बौधायनस्
22.6.125.m: As to the placing of the groups of bricks: Baudhāyana says, having gone through them with the tayādevatā formula, he should perform the sūdadohas verses at the end;
Śālīki says he should complete each group of bricks [individually].

22.6.125.s: abhimarśe 'bhihoma iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ purastād abhimarśābhihomābhyāṃ tayādevatasūdadohasaḥ kurvīteti ||
22.6.125.d: अभिमर्शे ऽभिहोम इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः पुरस्ताद् अभिमर्शाभिहोमाभ्यां तयादेवतसूददोहसः कुर्वीतेति ॥
22.6.125.m: As to the touching and the offering upon: the sūtra is of the two teachers; here Aupamanyava said: he should perform the tayādevatā and the sūdadohas verses before the touching and the offering upon.

22.6.126.s: sarpaśirasa upadhāna iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.6.126.d: सर्पशिरस उपधान इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.6.126.m: As to the placing of the snake's head: the former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.
As to [the requirement that] the mortar and pestle be of udumbara wood: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana;
Śālīki says he should make it only of a hardwood tree.

22.7.126.m: As to the pounding of all [kinds of] herbs: Baudhāyana says he should pound with a mantra;

22.7.126.s: ukhānām upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ekām evokhāṃ mantreṇopadadhyāt tūṣṇīm itare iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.7.126.d: उखानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । एकाम् एवोखां मन्त्रेणोपदध्यात् तूष्णीम् इतरे इति शालीकिः ॥
22.7.126.m: As to the placing of the ukhā pots: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should place only one ukhā pot with a mantra, the others silently.

22.7.126.s: paśuśīrṣāṇām upadhāna iti || madhya upadadhyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.7.126.d: पशुशीर्षाणाम् उपधान इति ॥ मध्य उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.7.126.m: As to the placing of the heads of the victims: Baudhāyana says he should place them in the middle;
Śālīki says he should place them at the edges of it, having cleared [a space].

22.7.126.s: atharvaśirasa upadhāna iti || purastāt sarvatomukham agreṇa svayamātṛṇṇām atra navarcam atharvaśira upadadhyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.7.126.d: अथर्वशिरस उपधान इति ॥ पुरस्तात् सर्वतोमुखम् अग्रेण स्वयमातृण्णाम् अत्र नवर्चम् अथर्वशिर उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.7.126.m: As to the placing of the atharvaśiras: Baudhāyana says, in front of the sarvatomukha, before the svayamātṛṇṇā brick, he should place the atharvaśiras of nine verses here;

22.7.126.s: sarvatomakhasyopadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | anudiśam eva gāyatrīr upadadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.7.126.d: सर्वतोमखस्योपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अनुदिशम् एव गायत्रीर् उपदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.7.126.m: As to the placing of the sarvatomukha: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should place the gāyatrī verses towards each quarter.

22.7.127.s: aṅgānām upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya vijñāteṣv evāṅgeṣv aṅgāny upadadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.7.127.d: अङ्गानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य विज्ञातेष्व् एवाङ्गेष्व् अङ्गान्य् उपदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.7.127.m: As to the placing of the limbs: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should place the limbs only on the known limbs.

22.7.127.s: ṛṣabhasyopadhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana īṣatpratyavahṛtaśirasam enam upadadhyād yatharṣabho vāśitum upatiṣṭhatīti ||
22.7.127.d: ऋषभस्योपधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन ईषत्प्रत्यवहृतशिरसम् एनम् उपदध्याद् यथर्षभो वाशितुम् उपतिष्ठतीति ॥
22.7.127.m: As to the placing of the bull: the sūtra is that of Śālīki; here Baudhāyana said: he should place it with its head slightly turned back, as a bull approaches a lowing [cow].

22.7.127.s: atītānām iṣṭakāgaṇānām upadhāna iti || ādhim upadadhyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.7.127.d: अतीतानाम् इष्टकागणानाम् उपधान इति ॥ आधिम् उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.7.127.m: As to the placing of the omitted groups of bricks: Baudhāyana says he should place an additional brick;

22.7.127.s: vratapradāna iti || madhyaṃdine vrataṃ prayacched iti baudhāyanas |
22.7.127.d: व्रतप्रदान इति ॥ मध्यंदिने व्रतं प्रयच्छेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.7.127.m: Regarding the offering of the fast-food: Baudhāyana says he should offer the fast-food at midday.

22.8.127.s: purīṣaciter upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pūrvedyur eva purīṣacitiṃ parinistiṣṭhed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.8.127.d: पुरीषचितेर् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पूर्वेद्युर् एव पुरीषचितिं परिनिस्तिष्ठेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.8.127.m: Regarding the laying down of the layer of loose earth: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says he should finish the layer of loose earth on the previous day itself.

22.8.127.s: aśvāvabhitas tiṣṭhetāṃ kṛṣṇā uttaraḥ śveto dakṣiṇa iti ||
22.8.127.d: अश्वावभितस् तिष्ठेतां कृष्णा उत्तरः श्वेतो दक्षिण इति ॥
22.8.127.m: Regarding: 'Two horses should stand on both sides, the black one on the north, the white one on the south':

22.8.127.s: atraivābhyāṃ tiṣṭhadbhyāṃ ghāsam āhārayed iti baudhāyanaḥ kālekāla evaināv udānayeyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.8.127.d: अत्रैवाभ्यां तिष्ठद्भ्यां घासम् आहारयेद् इति बौधायनः कालेकाल एवैनाव् उदानयेयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.8.127.m: Baudhāyana says fodder should be brought to them while they stand right here; Śālīki says they should bring them up only at the proper time.

22.8.127.s: vālakhilyānām upadhāna iti || upariṣṭād vālakhilyā upadadhyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.8.127.d: वालखिल्यानाम् उपधान इति ॥ उपरिष्टाद् वालखिल्या उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनः
22.8.127.m: Regarding the laying down of the Vālakhilyā [bricks]: Baudhāyana says he should lay down the Vālakhilyā [bricks] on top.

22.8.128.s: sṛṣṭīnām āyātana iti || agreṇa svayamātṛṇṇām udīcīrenā āyātayed ottarasmāt pakṣasaṃdheḥ sarvato veti ||
22.8.128.d: सृष्टीनाम् आयातन इति ॥ अग्रेण स्वयमातृण्णाम् उदीचीरेना आयातयेद् ओत्तरस्मात् पक्षसंधेः सर्वतो वेति ॥
22.8.128.m: Regarding the place of the Sṛṣṭi [bricks]: One should place them facing north to the east of the naturally-perforated [brick] up to the northern wing-joint, or all around.
The former view is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.8.128.s: vyuṣṭīnām upadhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ purastād enāḥ pratīcīr upadadhyāt
22.8.128.d: व्युष्टीनाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः पुरस्ताद् एनाः प्रतीचीर् उपदध्यात्
22.8.128.m: Regarding the laying down of the Vyuṣṭi [bricks]: The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: He should lay them down in the east facing west,
for the night shines away in the east, facing west.

22.8.128.s: tāsāṃ purīṣavatīṃ madhya upadadhātīti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ purīṣeṇa vā sahopadadhyāt purīṣaṃ vaiveti
22.8.128.d: तासां पुरीषवतीं मध्य उपदधातीति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः पुरीषेण वा सहोपदध्यात् पुरीषं वैवेति
22.8.128.m: Regarding: 'He places the [brick] with loose earth in their middle': Baudhāyana used to say: He should place it either together with loose earth, or just loose earth itself.
Śālīki says: It should have its loose earth merely through the mantra.

22.8.128.s: vairājānām upadhāna iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.8.128.d: वैराजानाम् उपधान इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.8.128.m: Regarding the laying down of the Vairāja [bricks]: The former view is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.8.128.s: yājñasenīnām upadhāna iti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasya ||
22.8.128.d: याज्ञसेनीनाम् उपधान इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य ॥
22.8.128.m: Regarding the laying down of the Yājñasenī [bricks]: The former view is Śālīki's, the latter Baudhāyana's.

22.8.128.s: ghṛteṣṭakānām upadhāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano ghṛtena vā sahopadadhyād ghṛtena vābhyajyeti
22.8.128.d: घृतेष्टकानाम् उपधान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो घृतेन वा सहोपदध्याद् घृतेन वाभ्यज्येति
22.8.128.m: Regarding the laying down of the ghee-bricks: Baudhāyana used to say: He should lay them down either together with ghee or having anointed them with ghee.
Śālīki says: They should have ghee merely through the mantra.
Aupamanyava says: He should lay down balls of ghee right here.

22.8.129.s: iṣṭakānām āvāpasthāna iti || antareṇa jyotiṣmatīś ca bhūteṣṭakāś caitad iṣṭakānām āvāpasyānaṃ bhavatīti ||
22.8.129.d: इष्टकानाम् आवापस्थान इति ॥ अन्तरेण ज्योतिष्मतीश् च भूतेष्टकाश् चैतद् इष्टकानाम् आवापस्यानं भवतीति ॥
22.8.129.m: Regarding the insertion-space for bricks: 'Between the Jyotiṣmatī [bricks] and the Bhūteṣṭakā [bricks] is the insertion-space for bricks.'

22.8.129.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ saṃveśanayajuḥ prabuddhayajuḥ prayāṇayajur aparyāṇayajuḥ sāmidhenīr āprīr atītām̐ś ceṣṭakāgaṇān atropadadhyād iti |
22.8.129.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनः संवेशनयजुः प्रबुद्धयजुः प्रयाणयजुर् अपर्याणयजुः सामिधेनीर् आप्रीर् अतीताँश् चेष्टकागणान् अत्रोपदध्याद् इति ।
22.8.129.m: Baudhāyana used to say: Here he should lay down the lying-down yajus, the awaking yajus, the departure yajus, the non-departure yajus, the kindle-verses, the Āprī [hymns], and the brick-groups that were omitted.

22.8.129.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir nāniṣṭakaṃ mantram iṣṭakāvad āpādayet |
22.8.129.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् नानिष्टकं मन्त्रम् इष्टकावद् आपादयेत् ।
22.8.129.m: Here Śālīki used to say: He should not bring in a brickless mantra as if it were a brick;
he should lay down here only the brick-groups that were omitted.

22.8.129.s: paurṇamāsyā upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | uttara evām̐se paurṇamāsīm upadadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.8.129.d: पौर्णमास्या उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । उत्तर एवाँसे पौर्णमासीम् उपदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.8.129.m: Regarding the laying down of the full-moon [brick]: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says he should lay down the full-moon [brick] only on the northern shoulder.

22.8.129.s: nakṣatreṣṭakānām upadhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pratitārakaṃ cātreṣṭakā upadadhyāt tatratatra ca rocayed iti ||
22.8.129.d: नक्षत्रेष्टकानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रतितारकं चात्रेष्टका उपदध्यात् तत्रतत्र च रोचयेद् इति ॥
22.8.129.m: Regarding the laying down of the Nakṣatra bricks: The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: He should lay down the bricks for each asterism here and illumine [them] in each respective place.

22.8.129.s: sarvatomukhasyopadhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano vyavetaṃ khalv idaṃ kṛṣṇasyābhimarśanena bhavati
22.8.129.d: सर्वतोमुखस्योपधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो व्यवेतं खल्व् इदं कृष्णस्याभिमर्शनेन भवति
22.8.129.m: Regarding the laying down of the Sarvatomukha [brick]: The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: This is indeed interrupted by touching the black [horse];

22.8.129.s: sarvatomukham upadhāsyañ chvetam aśvam abhimṛśed iti ||
22.8.129.d: सर्वतोमुखम् उपधास्यञ् छ्वेतम् अश्वम् अभिमृशेद् इति ॥
22.8.129.m: when about to lay down the Sarvatomukha [brick], he should touch the white horse.

22.8.129.s: vardhaneṣv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yāvanti vardhanāni samāne 'hani saṃnipateyuḥ sarveṣāṃ pāre tayādevatasūdadohasaḥ kurvīteti ||
22.8.129.d: वर्धनेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यावन्ति वर्धनानि समाने ऽहनि संनिपतेयुः सर्वेषां पारे तयादेवतसूददोहसः कुर्वीतेति ॥
22.8.129.m: Regarding the Vardhana [hymns]: The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: However many Vardhana [hymns] occur on the same day, beyond all of them he should perform the tayādevatā and the sūdadohas verses.

22.9.130.s: atha prokṣaṇīṣu hiraṇyaśalkān pratyasyaty ūrdhvaṃ tribhyo 'parimitān iti sahasram iti proktaṃ ||
22.9.130.d: अथ प्रोक्षणीषु हिरण्यशल्कान् प्रत्यस्यत्य् ऊर्ध्वं त्रिभ्यो ऽपरिमितान् इति सहस्रम् इति प्रोक्तं ॥
22.9.130.m: Then regarding: 'Into the sprinkling waters he throws pieces of gold, more than three, an unlimited number', or 'A thousand' is stated:
The former view is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.9.130.s: śatarudrīyasya homa iti || sūtram ācāryayoḥ pūrvasminn evānīke juhuyād iti gautamaḥ ||
22.9.130.d: शतरुद्रीयस्य होम इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोः पूर्वस्मिन्न् एवानीके जुहुयाद् इति गौतमः ॥
22.9.130.m: Regarding the offering of the Śatarudrīya: The sūtra belongs to both teachers. Gautama says he should offer only in the eastern row.

22.9.130.s: namaskārair upasthāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sadhanuṣka evopatiṣṭhetottarasyā eva diśa āvṛtyaitenaiva yathetam etya paścāt prāṅ tiṣṭhann ūrdhvām upatiṣṭheteti |
22.9.130.d: नमस्कारैर् उपस्थान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः सधनुष्क एवोपतिष्ठेतोत्तरस्या एव दिश आवृत्यैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य पश्चात् प्राङ् तिष्ठन्न् ऊर्ध्वाम् उपतिष्ठेतेति ।
22.9.130.m: Regarding the attendance with homages: Baudhāyana used to say: He should attend [to the fire] while still holding the bow; having turned around from the northern quarter, going by the way he came, standing in the west facing east, he should attend to the upright [flame].

22.9.130.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir dattvaiva dhanur upatiṣṭhetaitasyai caiva diśa āvṛtyaitenaiva yathetam etya paścāt prāṅ tiṣṭhann ūrdhvām upatiṣṭheteti ||
22.9.130.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् दत्त्वैव धनुर् उपतिष्ठेतैतस्यै चैव दिश आवृत्यैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य पश्चात् प्राङ् तिष्ठन्न् ऊर्ध्वाम् उपतिष्ठेतेति ॥
22.9.130.m: Here Śālīki used to say: Having given away the bow he should attend; and having turned around from this quarter, going by the way he came, standing in the west facing east, he should attend to the upright [flame].
Regarding: 'While it is being sprinkled around, he makes the sacrificer recite': The sūtra is Śālīki's.

22.9.130.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pariṣicyapariṣicyaivāśmani kumbhaṃ nidadhyāt |
22.9.130.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः परिषिच्यपरिषिच्यैवाश्मनि कुम्भं निदध्यात् ।
22.9.130.m: Here Baudhāyana used to say: After sprinkling again and again, he should place the jar on the stone;

22.9.130.s: aśmam̐s te kṣud amuṃ te śug ṛcchatu | ity abhinirdiśed yaṃ dviṣyād iti ||
22.9.130.d: अश्मँस् ते क्षुद् अमुं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु । इत्य् अभिनिर्दिशेद् यं द्विष्याद् इति ॥
22.9.130.m: he should indicate whoever he hates with: 'On the stone be your hunger, on that one let your grief go.'

22.9.130.s: vikarṣaṇa iti || ardharcaśo vikarṣed iti baudhāyanas |
22.9.130.d: विकर्षण इति ॥ अर्धर्चशो विकर्षेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.9.130.m: Regarding the dragging [of the frog, etc.]: Baudhāyana says he should drag [them] half-verse by half-verse.

22.9.131.s: svayamātṛṇṇāyai vyāghāraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | agnicaturaśrām enāṃ vyāghārayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.9.131.d: स्वयमातृण्णायै व्याघारण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अग्निचतुरश्राम् एनां व्याघारयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.9.131.m: Regarding the trickling of ghee onto the naturally-perforated [brick]: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says he should trickle it onto this [brick] in four corners like the fire-altar.

22.9.131.s: vaiśvānaramārutānāṃ mantrāmantra iti || mantravantaḥ syur iti baudhāyanas
22.9.131.d: वैश्वानरमारुतानां मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवन्तः स्युर् इति बौधायनस्
22.9.131.m: Regarding whether the Vaiśvānara and Māruta [offerings] have mantras or not: Baudhāyana says they should have mantras.

22.9.131.s: tūṣṇīkā iti śālīkis | vaiśvānara eva mantravān syāt tūṣṇīkā mārutā ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.9.131.d: तूष्णीका इति शालीकिस् । वैश्वानर एव मन्त्रवान् स्यात् तूष्णीका मारुता इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.9.131.m: Śālīki says: They should be silent. Aupamanyava says: The Vaiśvānara should have a mantra; the Māruta [offerings] should be silent.

22.9.131.s: ānīkavatasya homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āhavanīya evānīkavataṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.9.131.d: आनीकवतस्य होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आहवनीय एवानीकवतं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.9.131.m: Regarding the offering of the Ānīkavata: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says he should offer the Ānīkavata only in the āhavanīya fire.

22.9.131.s: athainam̐ saṃcitam ājyaprokṣeṇa prokṣatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
22.9.131.d: अथैनँ संचितम् आज्यप्रोक्षेण प्रोक्षतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
22.9.131.m: Regarding: 'Then he sprinkles it, fully piled, with a sprinkling of clarified butter': The sūtra is Śālīki's.

22.9.131.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyano mantrānudiśaṃ cainaṃ prokṣan mantrānulokaṃ ceti ||
22.9.131.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो मन्त्रानुदिशं चैनं प्रोक्षन् मन्त्रानुलोकं चेति ॥
22.9.131.m: Here Baudhāyana used to say: While sprinkling it, [it should be done] following the directions of the mantra and following the worlds of the mantra.

22.9.131.s: idhmasya nidhāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayenedhmaṃ nidadhyād ādhvarikeṇa cāgnikena ceti |
22.9.131.d: इध्मस्य निधान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उभयेनेध्मं निदध्याद् आध्वरिकेण चाग्निकेन चेति ।
22.9.131.m: Regarding the placement of the kindling wood: Baudhāyana used to say: He should place the kindling wood with both, the one for the basic sacrifice and the one for the fire-altar.
Śālīki says: Only with the one for the fire-altar.

22.10.131.s: śākalaiḥ paridhāna iti || āhavanīyaṃ paridadhyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.10.131.d: शाकलैः परिधान इति ॥ आहवनीयं परिदध्याद् इति बौधायनः
22.10.131.m: Regarding the enclosing with chips of wood: Baudhāyana says he should enclose the āhavanīya fire.

22.10.131.s: sruvāhutyoḥ karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.10.131.d: स्रुवाहुत्योः करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.10.131.m: Regarding the making of the two ladle libations: Baudhāyana says he should make them; Śālīki says he should not make them.

22.10.131.s: pūrṇāhutyai karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.10.131.d: पूर्णाहुत्यै करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.10.131.m: Regarding the making of the full-spoon libation: Baudhāyana says he should make it; Śālīki says he should not make it.

22.10.131.s: atra juhvan manasā diśo dhyāyed iti || digbhyo 'ham agnim abhisaṃbharāṇi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
22.10.131.d: अत्र जुह्वन् मनसा दिशो ध्यायेद् इति ॥ दिग्भ्यो ऽहम् अग्निम् अभिसंभराणि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
22.10.131.m: Regarding: 'Offering here, he should meditate on the quarters in his mind': Either with 'From the quarters I gather the fire together' or silently.

22.10.132.m: The former view is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.10.132.s: prasekasyāyātana iti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasya ||
22.10.132.d: प्रसेकस्यायातन इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य ॥
22.10.132.m: Regarding the place of the water-stream: The former view is Śālīki's, the latter Baudhāyana's.

22.10.132.s: tasmim̐ś catura upastṛṇāna āheti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.10.132.d: तस्मिँश् चतुर उपस्तृणान आहेति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.10.132.m: Regarding: 'Spreading four [leaves of reed] on it, he says': The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
Śālīki says: He should not spread them.
Regarding the throwing after of the water-stream [reed]: Baudhāyana says he should throw it after.
Śālīki says: He should not throw it after.

22.10.132.s: brahmaudanasya śrapaṇa iti || agnyādheyavac chrapayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.10.132.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य श्रपण इति ॥ अग्न्याधेयवच् छ्रपयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.10.132.m: Regarding the boiling of the brahmaudana: Baudhāyana says he should boil it as in the establishment of the fires.

22.10.132.s: brahmaudanasya prāśana iti || uttare śroṇyante prāśnīyur iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.10.132.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य प्राशन इति ॥ उत्तरे श्रोण्यन्ते प्राश्नीयुर् इति बौधायनः
22.10.132.m: Regarding the eating of the brahmaudana: Baudhāyana says they should eat on the northern corner of the hip.
Śālīki says: Around the tail itself.

22.10.132.s: vātanāmānām̐ homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya vātam apy atrāñjalinā juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ
22.10.132.d: वातनामानाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य वातम् अप्य् अत्राञ्जलिना जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः
22.10.132.m: As to the offering of the vātanāma oblations: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should offer wind also here with his joined hands;
Aupamanyava says he should offer with a fold of black-antelope skin.

22.10.132.s: śākalānām anupraharaṇa iti || anuprahared iti baudhāyanas |
22.10.132.d: शाकलानाम् अनुप्रहरण इति ॥ अनुप्रहरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.10.132.m: As to the throwing along of the chips: Baudhāyana says he should throw [them] along;
Śālīki says he should not throw [them] along.

22.11.132.s: agnidhiṣṇiyānām upadhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sarvā eva yājuṣīr upadadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.11.132.d: अग्निधिष्णियानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सर्वा एव याजुषीर् उपदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.11.132.m: As to the placing of the agnidhiṣṇiya bricks: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should place all those that are accompanied by yajus.

22.11.133.s: nānābījānāṃ nirvapaṇa iti || nirvapaṇenānusametya vyabhimṛśed iti baudhāyanas
22.11.133.d: नानाबीजानां निर्वपण इति ॥ निर्वपणेनानुसमेत्य व्यभिमृशेद् इति बौधायनस्
22.11.133.m: As to the apportioning of the various seeds: Baudhāyana says, having proceeded along with the apportioning, he should touch each separately;

22.11.133.s: tattad eva haviḥ parinistiṣṭhed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.11.133.d: तत्तद् एव हविः परिनिस्तिष्ठेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.11.133.m: Śālīki says he should complete each oblation [individually].

22.11.133.s: teṣāṃ vrīhiṣv eva haviṣkṛtam udvādayaty upodyacchante yavān iti ||
22.11.133.d: तेषां व्रीहिष्व् एव हविष्कृतम् उद्वादयत्य् उपोद्यच्छन्ते यवान् इति ॥
22.11.133.m: As to [the rule]: "For them, he utters the haviṣkṛt call over the rice grains only, and they lift up the barley grains":

22.11.133.s: sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana āvapanaprabhṛti yaveṣu mantrakarmābhyāvarteta tantraṃ tu haviṣkṛt syād iti ||
22.11.133.d: सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन आवपनप्रभृति यवेषु मन्त्रकर्माभ्यावर्तेत तन्त्रं तु हविष्कृत् स्याद् इति ॥
22.11.133.m: the sūtra is that of Śālīki; here Baudhāyana said: from the pouring in onwards, the rite with mantras should be repeated for the barley, but the haviṣkṛt call should be common to both.

22.11.133.s: āpyaninayana iti || jaghanena gārhapatyam āpyebhyo ninayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.11.133.d: आप्यनिनयन इति ॥ जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् आप्येभ्यो निनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.11.133.m: As to the pouring out [of the water] for the Āpyas: Baudhāyana says he should pour out for the Āpyas behind the gārhapatya fire;

22.11.133.s: agreṇātihāyeti śālīkis | agreṇa vā jaghanena vety aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.11.133.d: अग्रेणातिहायेति शालीकिस् । अग्रेण वा जघनेन वेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.11.133.m: Śālīki says [he should pour out] having passed by the front; Aupamanyava says either in front or behind.

22.11.133.s: sacarupaśupuroḍāśā evetareṣām̐ haviṣām iḍā avadyed abhyardhād veti
22.11.133.d: सचरुपशुपुरोडाशा एवेतरेषाँ हविषाम् इडा अवद्येद् अभ्यर्धाद् वेति
22.11.133.m: As to [the question whether] he cuts off the portions of the iḍā together with the boiled rice mess and the animal sacrificial cake from the other oblations, or separately,

22.11.133.s: sapaśupuroḍāśānāṃ veti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.11.133.d: सपशुपुरोडाशानां वेति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.11.133.m: or together with the animal sacrificial cakes: the former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

22.11.133.s: atyākramaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya saha sviṣṭakṛtātyākrāmed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.11.133.d: अत्याक्रमण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सह स्विष्टकृतात्याक्रामेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.11.133.m: As to the stepping across: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should step across together with the sviṣṭakṛt offering.

22.11.133.s: abhiṣeka iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ purastāt sviṣṭakṛto yāvad āmnātenābhiṣiñcen nātra kṛṣṇājinaṃ na rukmau na pārthāni bhavanti kuśān eva sam̐stīrya teṣv enam abhiṣiñced iti ||
22.11.133.d: अभिषेक इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो यावद् आम्नातेनाभिषिञ्चेन् नात्र कृष्णाजिनं न रुक्मौ न पार्थानि भवन्ति कुशान् एव सँस्तीर्य तेष्व् एनम् अभिषिञ्चेद् इति ॥
22.11.133.m: As to the unction: the sūtra is of the two teachers; here Aupamanyava said: before the sviṣṭakṛt offering he should sprinkle him as prescribed; here there is no black-antelope skin, no two gold plates, no Pārtha libations; having spread out kuśa grass alone, he should sprinkle him on it.

22.11.134.s: yoge vimoka iti || aharahar yuñjyād aharahar vimuñced iti baudhāyanas |
22.11.134.d: योगे विमोक इति ॥ अहरहर् युञ्ज्याद् अहरहर् विमुञ्चेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.11.134.m: As to the harnessing and unharnessing: Baudhāyana says he should harness day by day and unharness day by day;

22.11.134.s: aharahar yuñjyād ante vimuñced iti śālīkis | ādita eva yuñjyād ante vimuñced ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.11.134.d: अहरहर् युञ्ज्याद् अन्ते विमुञ्चेद् इति शालीकिस् । आदित एव युञ्ज्याद् अन्ते विमुञ्चेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.11.134.m: Śālīki says he should harness day by day and unharness at the end; Aupamanyava says he should harness right from the beginning and unharness at the end.

22.11.134.s: kratukaraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yathākratv evāsya kratukaraṇāni kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.11.134.d: क्रतुकरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यथाक्रत्व् एवास्य क्रतुकरणानि कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.11.134.m: As to the kratukaraṇa rites: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should perform the kratukaraṇa rites for him according to each rite.

22.11.134.s: aikādaśinānāṃ paśūnām upākaraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
22.11.134.d: ऐकादशिनानां पशूनाम् उपाकरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
22.11.134.m: As to the bringing up of the eleven victims: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana;

22.11.134.s: ekayūpa evaikādaśinān paśūn upākuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.11.134.d: एकयूप एवैकादशिनान् पशून् उपाकुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.11.134.m: Śālīki says he should bring up the eleven victims at a single sacrificial post.

22.12.134.s: vapānāṃ parihoma iti || tāṃtāṃ parijuhuyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.12.134.d: वपानां परिहोम इति ॥ तांतां परिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.12.134.m: As to the offering around of the omenta: Baudhāyana says he should offer around each one;

22.12.134.s: āditaś cāntataś ceti śālīkiḥ || aśvasyāvaghrāpaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya mādhyaṃdina eva savane 'śvam avaghrāpayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.12.134.d: आदितश् चान्ततश् चेति शालीकिः ॥ अश्वस्यावघ्रापण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य माध्यंदिन एव सवने ऽश्वम् अवघ्रापयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.12.134.m: Śālīki says [he should offer around] at the beginning and at the end. As to making the horse smell: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; Śālīki says he should make the horse smell at the midday pressing only.

22.12.134.s: paśūnām āsādana iti || paśuṃpaśuṃ pañcahotrāsādayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.12.134.d: पशूनाम् आसादन इति ॥ पशुंपशुं पञ्चहोत्रासादयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.12.134.m: As to the setting down of the victims: Baudhāyana says he should set down victim after victim with the pañcahotṛ formula;

22.12.134.s: hṛdayaśūlānām udvāsana iti || ekaikaśa udvāsayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.12.134.d: हृदयशूलानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ एकैकश उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनः
22.12.134.m: As to the taking out of the heart-spits: Baudhāyana says he should take [them] out one by one;

22.12.135.s: āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti || mantravatī ca syād adhyavadānīyā ceti baudhāyanas
22.12.135.d: आमिक्षायै मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवती च स्याद् अध्यवदानीया चेति बौधायनस्
22.12.135.m: As to whether the curd is accompanied by a mantra or without a mantra: Baudhāyana says it should be accompanied by a mantra and portions should be cut from it;

22.12.135.s: tūṣṇīkā ca syād adhyavadānīyā ceti śālīkis |
22.12.135.d: तूष्णीका च स्याद् अध्यवदानीया चेति शालीकिस् ।
22.12.135.m: Śālīki says it should be silent and portions should be cut from it;

22.12.135.s: mantravatī ca syāt tantraharayā cainayā niruāḍhayā yajetety aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.12.135.d: मन्त्रवती च स्यात् तन्त्रहरया चैनया निरुआढया यजेतेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.12.135.m: Aupamanyava says it should be accompanied by a mantra and he should sacrifice with it carried through as an independent offering.

22.12.135.s: devikāhaviṣāṃ karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.12.135.d: देविकाहविषां करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.12.135.m: As to the performing of the devikā oblations: Baudhāyana says he should perform [them]; Śālīki says he should not perform [them].

22.13.135.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the Vājapeya sacrifice.

22.13.135.s: cinvīta vājapeye 'gnim iti baudhāyanas | na cinvīteti śālīkiḥ ||
22.13.135.d: चिन्वीत वाजपेये ऽग्निम् इति बौधायनस् । न चिन्वीतेति शालीकिः ॥
22.13.135.m: One should pile the fire-altar in the Vājapeya, says Baudhāyana; one should not pile it, says Śālīki.

22.13.135.s: audumbaram̐ rathacakram̐ saptadaśāram iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.13.135.d: औदुम्बरँ रथचक्रँ सप्तदशारम् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.13.135.m: Regarding the chariot wheel made of udumbara wood with seventeen spokes: this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.
One should make it of any strong wood, says Śālīki.

22.13.135.s: khādirīṃ vitṛṇṇīṃ vadhrair vyūtām upakalpayata iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.13.135.d: खादिरीं वितृण्णीं वध्रैर् व्यूताम् उपकल्पयत इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.13.135.m: Regarding: 'He prepares a perforated piece of khadira wood interwoven with thongs': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.13.135.s: bastājinaṃ caivātropakalpayīta śatamānaṃ ca hiraṇyam iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.13.135.d: बस्ताजिनं चैवात्रोपकल्पयीत शतमानं च हिरण्यम् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.13.135.m: He should prepare here a goat-skin and gold weighing a hundred mānas, says Śālīki.

22.13.135.s: sa grīṣmasya jaghanyāhaḥsu purastād āṣāḍhyai paurṇamāsyai dīkṣata iti ||
22.13.135.d: स ग्रीष्मस्य जघन्याहःसु पुरस्ताद् आषाढ्यै पौर्णमास्यै दीक्षत इति ॥
22.13.135.m: Regarding: 'He undergoes initiation on the last days of summer, before the Āṣāḍhī full moon':

22.13.135.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya śaradi vājapeyena yajeteti śālīkiḥ ||
22.13.135.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य शरदि वाजपेयेन यजेतेति शालीकिः ॥
22.13.135.m: this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. One should perform the Vājapeya in autumn, says Śālīki.

22.13.136.s: sāvitrāṇām̐ homa iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.13.136.d: सावित्राणाँ होम इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding the offering of the Sāvitra libations: the first option is Baudhāyana's, the second Śālīki's.

22.13.136.s: vājapeyikāyai surāyai saṃdhāna iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo yatraiva surā syāt tata āhārayed iti ||
22.13.136.d: वाजपेयिकायै सुरायै संधान इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो यत्रैव सुरा स्यात् तत आहारयेद् इति ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding the compounding of the surā for the Vājapeya: this is the sūtra of the two teachers; but Aupamanyava used to say: wherever there may be surā, one should fetch it from there.

22.13.136.s: so 'ratnimātre 'ratnimātre vā vigrathnāti dhanurveṣṭīr vā praveṣṭayatīti ||
22.13.136.d: सो ऽरत्निमात्रे ऽरत्निमात्रे वा विग्रथ्नाति धनुर्वेष्टीर् वा प्रवेष्टयतीति ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding: 'He ties knots at every fore-arm length, or he fastens bow-coverings':
the first option is Baudhāyana's, the second Śālīki's.

22.13.136.s: gaudhūmaṃ caṣālam iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya godhūmapiṣṭānām api kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.13.136.d: गौधूमं चषालम् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य गोधूमपिष्टानाम् अपि कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding the wheat head-piece: this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. One may also make it from wheat flour, says Śālīki.

22.13.136.s: dundubhīnām āsañjana iti || sūtraṃ dvaidham evaitad bhavati ||
22.13.136.d: दुन्दुभीनाम् आसञ्जन इति ॥ सूत्रं द्वैधम् एवैतद् भवति ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding the suspending of the drums: the sūtra is divided on this.

22.13.136.s: kratukaraṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'tirātram apy atra kratum upeyāt samānapakṣe cainam̐ saṃtiṣṭhāpayiṣed iti ||
22.13.136.d: क्रतुकरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽतिरात्रम् अप्य् अत्र क्रतुम् उपेयात् समानपक्षे चैनँ संतिष्ठापयिषेद् इति ॥
22.13.136.m: Regarding the form of the sacrifice: this is the sūtra of Śālīki; but Baudhāyana used to say: one should adopt here even the atirātra sacrifice, and should conclude it in the same fortnight.

22.14.136.s: pañcaindrānatigrāhyān gṛhṇātīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sarva evaite somayāmā grahītavyā bhavantīti śālīkiḥ ||
22.14.136.d: पञ्चैन्द्रानतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णातीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सर्व एवैते सोमयामा ग्रहीतव्या भवन्तीति शालीकिः ॥
22.14.136.m: Regarding: 'He draws five extra soma-cups for Indra': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. All these soma courses should be drawn, says Śālīki.

22.14.136.s: surāgrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyansya sajuṣṭān parimṛjya sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.14.136.d: सुराग्रहाणां ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायन्स्य सजुष्टान् परिमृज्य सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.14.136.m: Regarding the drawing of the surā cups: this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. Having wiped around those which are accepted, he should place them down, says Śālīki.

22.14.137.s: dviśreṇi vā triśreṇi vodīca āyātayatīti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.14.137.d: द्विश्रेणि वा त्रिश्रेणि वोदीच आयातयतीति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.14.137.m: Regarding: 'He aligns them towards the north in two rows or in three rows': the first option is Baudhāyana's, the second Śālīki's.

22.14.137.s: ṣaḍraśanā ādāya yūpam abhipreyād iti baudhāyanaḥ pañca raśanā ādāya yūpam abhipreyād iti śālīkis |
22.14.137.d: षड्रशना आदाय यूपम् अभिप्रेयाद् इति बौधायनः पञ्च रशना आदाय यूपम् अभिप्रेयाद् इति शालीकिस् ।
22.14.137.m: Having taken six cords, he should approach the sacrificial post, says Baudhāyana. Having taken five cords, he should approach the sacrificial post, says Śālīki.

22.14.137.s: catasro raśanā ādāya yūpam abhipreyād ity aupamanyavas |
22.14.137.d: चतस्रो रशना आदाय यूपम् अभिप्रेयाद् इत्य् औपमन्यवस् ।
22.14.137.m: Having taken four cords, he should approach the sacrificial post, says Aupamanyava.

22.14.137.s: ekām eva raśanām ādāya yūpam abhipreyād ity aupamanyavīputras |
22.14.137.d: एकाम् एव रशनाम् आदाय यूपम् अभिप्रेयाद् इत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रस् ।
22.14.137.m: Having taken only one cord, he should approach the sacrificial post, says Aupamanyavīputra.
He should bind [them] only to the cord of the victim for Agni and Soma, says Āñjīgavi.

22.14.137.s: vājapeyikānāṃ paśūnām upākaraṇa iti || aikādaśinān upākṛtya vājapeyikān upākuryād iti baudhāyanas |
22.14.137.d: वाजपेयिकानां पशूनाम् उपाकरण इति ॥ ऐकादशिनान् उपाकृत्य वाजपेयिकान् उपाकुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.14.137.m: Regarding the dedication of the animal victims of the Vājapeya: having dedicated the set of eleven animals, he should dedicate the Vājapeya victims, says Baudhāyana.
Only the Vājapeya victims, by no means the set of eleven animals, says Śālīki.

22.14.137.s: prājāpatyānām upākaraṇa iti || ekaikaśa upākuryād iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.14.137.d: प्राजापत्यानाम् उपाकरण इति ॥ एकैकश उपाकुर्याद् इति बौधायनः
22.14.137.m: Regarding the dedication of the animals for Prajāpati: he should dedicate them one by one, says Baudhāyana.

22.14.137.s: vapānāṃ parihoma iti || tāṃtāṃ parijuhuyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.14.137.d: वपानां परिहोम इति ॥ तांतां परिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.14.137.m: Regarding the circum-immolation libations of the omenta: he should make the libation around each one, says Baudhāyana.
At the beginning and at the end, says Śālīki.

22.14.137.s: hṛdayaśūlānām udvāsana iti || ekaikaśa udvāsayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.14.137.d: हृदयशूलानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ एकैकश उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनः
22.14.137.m: Regarding the taking down of the heart-spits: he should take them down one by one, says Baudhāyana.

22.14.137.s: rathānām abhiyojana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano ya evaiṣa samavakṣepaṇo mantras taṃ prathamam abhiyojanānāṃ kuryāt |
22.14.137.d: रथानाम् अभियोजन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो य एवैष समवक्षेपणो मन्त्रस् तं प्रथमम् अभियोजनानां कुर्यात् ।
22.14.137.m: Regarding the harnessing of the chariots: this is the sūtra of Śālīki; but Baudhāyana used to say: that mantra which is used for throwing down together, that he should make the first of the harnessing mantras,
and then he should throw down together [the whips] upon the horses silently.

22.14.137.s: kāṣṭhāgamana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyaitāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ gaccheyur athāmuto 'pasalair āvarterann iti |
22.14.137.d: काष्ठागमन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्यैतां काष्ठां गच्छेयुर् अथामुतो ऽपसलैर् आवर्तेरन्न् इति ।
22.14.137.m: Regarding reaching the race-goal: Baudhāyana used to say: turning to the right, they should go to this race-goal, and then from there they should turn back to the left;

22.14.138.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir apasalair āvṛtyaitāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ gaccheyur athāmutaḥ pradakṣiṇam āvarterann iti ||
22.14.138.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अपसलैर् आवृत्यैतां काष्ठां गच्छेयुर् अथामुतः प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तेरन्न् इति ॥
22.14.138.m: whereas Śālīki used to say: turning to the left, they should go to this race-goal, and then from there they should turn back to the right.

22.15.138.s: atha yajamānaṃ tārpyaṃ paridhāpayatīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
22.15.138.d: अथ यजमानं तार्प्यं परिधापयतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
22.15.138.m: Regarding: 'Then he clothes the sacrificer in a silk garment': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.15.138.s: ubhe evaite yajamānaṃ paridhāpayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.15.138.d: उभे एवैते यजमानं परिधापयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.15.138.m: He should clothe the sacrificer in both of these garments, says Śālīki.

22.15.138.s: śrityā āyātana iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.15.138.d: श्रित्या आयातन इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.15.138.m: Regarding the setting up of the ladder: the first option is Baudhāyana's, the second Śālīki's.

22.15.138.s: tāṃ daśabhiḥ kalpai rohatīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | etair eva mantraiḥ pratyavarohed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.15.138.d: तां दशभिः कल्पै रोहतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । एतैर् एव मन्त्रैः प्रत्यवरोहेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.15.138.m: Regarding: 'He mounts it with ten formulas': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. He should dismount with these same mantras, says Śālīki.

22.15.138.s: atrāsmai pratyavarohaṇata āsandīṃ nidadhātīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.15.138.d: अत्रास्मै प्रत्यवरोहणत आसन्दीं निदधातीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.15.138.m: Regarding: 'Here he places a low chair for him where he dismounts': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.15.138.s: bastājinaṃ caivāsyātra pratyavarohec chatamānaṃ ca hiraṇyam iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.15.138.d: बस्ताजिनं चैवास्यात्र प्रत्यवरोहेच् छतमानं च हिरण्यम् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.15.138.m: He should dismount here upon a goat-skin and upon gold weighing a hundred mānas, says Śālīki.

22.15.139.s: athainam etayāsandyā sada āvahantyā vā vrajatīti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.15.139.d: अथैनम् एतयासन्द्या सद आवहन्त्या वा व्रजतीति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.15.139.m: Regarding: 'Then they carry him in this low chair to the sadas shed, or he walks': the first option is Baudhāyana's, the second Śālīki's.

22.15.139.s: atigrāhyāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasya ||
22.15.139.d: अतिग्राह्याणां भक्षण इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य ॥
22.15.139.m: Regarding the consumption of the extra cups: the first option is Śālīki's, the second Baudhāyana's.

22.15.139.s: prājāpatyānāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasy ||
22.15.139.d: प्राजापत्यानां भक्षण इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य् ॥
22.15.139.m: Regarding the consumption of the victims for Prajāpati: the first option is Śālīki's, the second Baudhāyana's.

22.15.139.s: gudatṛtīyeṣv iti || dvedve atra gudatṛtīye upayaṣṭopayajed iti baudhāyanas |
22.15.139.d: गुदतृतीयेष्व् इति ॥ द्वेद्वे अत्र गुदतृतीये उपयष्टोपयजेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.15.139.m: Regarding the third-parts of the intestines: here the assistant priest should sacrifice the third-parts of the intestines two by two as secondary offerings, says Baudhāyana.

22.15.139.s: apacchedam iti śālīkiḥ samastāny evaitāny anuprahṛtya sarvair mantrair anumantrayetety aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.15.139.d: अपच्छेदम् इति शालीकिः समस्तान्य् एवैतान्य् अनुप्रहृत्य सर्वैर् मन्त्रैर् अनुमन्त्रयेतेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.15.139.m: By cutting [them] off, says Śālīki. Having thrown all of them into the fire together, he should follow them with all the mantras, says Aupamanyava.

22.16.139.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the Rājasūya sacrifice.

22.16.139.s: cinvīta rājasūye 'gnim iti baudhāyanas | na cinvīteti śālīkiḥ ||
22.16.139.d: चिन्वीत राजसूये ऽग्निम् इति बौधायनस् । न चिन्वीतेति शालीकिः ॥
22.16.139.m: One should pile the fire-altar in the Rājasūya, says Baudhāyana; one should not pile it, says Śālīki.

22.16.139.s: punar adhyupya piṣṭāni kṛtvāhārayed iti baudhāyanas tathādhyuptāny evaitāni syur iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.16.139.d: पुनर् अध्युप्य पिष्टानि कृत्वाहारयेद् इति बौधायनस् तथाध्युप्तान्य् एवैतानि स्युर् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.16.139.m: Having ground [the grains] again and made them into flour, one should bring them, says Baudhāyana; they should be just as ground [the first time], says Śālīki.

22.16.139.s: nairṛtasya mantrāmantra iti || mantravānsyād iti baudhāyanas
22.16.139.d: नैरृतस्य मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवान्स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
22.16.139.m: Regarding the use or non-use of mantras for the oblation to Nirṛti: it should be accompanied by mantras, says Baudhāyana;

22.16.139.s: ekolmukasya haraṇa iti || anvāhāryapacanād dhared iti baudhāyanas |
22.16.139.d: एकोल्मुकस्य हरण इति ॥ अन्वाहार्यपचनाद् धरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.16.139.m: Regarding fetching a single firebrand: he should fetch it from the anvāhāryapacana fire, says Baudhāyana;

22.16.139.s: nairṛtasya homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya visram̐sikākāṇḍābhyām enaṃ parigṛhya juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.16.139.d: नैरृतस्य होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य विस्रँसिकाकाण्डाभ्याम् एनं परिगृह्य जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.16.139.m: Regarding the offering to Nirṛti: this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. Having seized it with two cracked reeds, he should make the offering, says Śālīki.

22.16.140.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti || aharahar dadyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.16.140.d: दक्षिणानां दान इति ॥ अहरहर् दद्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.16.140.m: Regarding the giving of sacrificial gifts: he should give day by day, says Baudhāyana;
at the beginning and at the end, says Śālīki.

22.16.140.s: udapātrasyopaninayana iti || pradakṣiṇam upaninayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.16.140.d: उदपात्रस्योपनिनयन इति ॥ प्रदक्षिणम् उपनिनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.16.140.m: Regarding the pouring out of the water-vessel: he should pour it out from left to right, says Baudhāyana;
as it happens to fall, says Śālīki.

22.16.140.s: svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra | iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āntam apy atra svāhākārāṃ pariṇayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.16.140.d: स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकार । इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आन्तम् अप्य् अत्र स्वाहाकारां परिणयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.16.140.m: Regarding: 'Svāhā! Homage to him who has done this': this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. He should lead him around accompanied by the svāhā call up to the end here, says Śālīki.

22.16.140.s: saṃtanīnām anuprayoga iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yad ahar iṣṭyā vā paśunā vā yajetāpi tad ahaḥ saṃtanī prayuñjīteti |
22.16.140.d: संतनीनाम् अनुप्रयोग इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यद् अहर् इष्ट्या वा पशुना वा यजेतापि तद् अहः संतनी प्रयुञ्जीतेति ।
22.16.140.m: Regarding the continuous performance of the Saṃtanī offerings: Baudhāyana used to say: on whichever day he sacrifices with an iṣṭi or with an animal sacrifice, on that day too he should employ the Saṃtanī offerings.

22.16.140.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir aharahar āśrāvaṇārthe khalv ete dṛṣṭe bhavatas |
22.16.140.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अहरहर् आश्रावणार्थे खल्व् एते दृष्टे भवतस् ।
22.16.140.m: On this matter Śālīki indeed said: "These two are seen only for the purpose of the daily call.

22.16.140.s: yad ahar iṣṭyā vā paśunā vā yajeta na tad ahaḥ saṃtanī prayuñjīteti ||
22.16.140.d: यद् अहर् इष्ट्या वा पशुना वा यजेत न तद् अहः संतनी प्रयुञ्जीतेति ॥
22.16.140.m: On the day when he sacrifices with an iṣṭi or with an animal offering, on that day he should not employ the continuous libations."

22.16.140.s: cāturmāsyānām anuprayoga iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yad ahaś cāturmāsyāni prayuñjītāpi tad ahaḥ saṃtanī prayuñjīteti |
22.16.140.d: चातुर्मास्यानाम् अनुप्रयोग इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यद् अहश् चातुर्मास्यानि प्रयुञ्जीतापि तद् अहः संतनी प्रयुञ्जीतेति ।
22.16.140.m: Regarding the employment [of continuous libations] at the Cāturmāsya sacrifices: / Baudhāyana indeed said: "On the day when he employs the Cāturmāsya sacrifices, he should also employ the continuous libations on that day."

22.16.140.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir aharahar āśrāvaṇārthe khalv ete dṛṣṭe bhavatas |
22.16.140.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अहरहर् आश्रावणार्थे खल्व् एते दृष्टे भवतस् ।
22.16.140.m: On this matter Śālīki indeed said: "These two are seen only for the purpose of the daily call.

22.16.140.s: yad ahaś cāturmāsyāni prayuñjīta na tad ahaḥ saṃtanī prayuñjīteti ||
22.16.140.d: यद् अहश् चातुर्मास्यानि प्रयुञ्जीत न तद् अहः संतनी प्रयुञ्जीतेति ॥
22.16.140.m: On the day when he employs the Cāturmāsya sacrifices, he should not employ the continuous libations on that day."
The performance of the rite with five kindling sticks has been explained.

22.17.140.s: athopaveṣeṇāṅgārān samūhatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas tūṣṇīm aṅgārān samūhyāthainān sruvāhutibhir abhijuhuyāt | agnaye rakṣoghne svāhā | iti pañcabhis |
22.17.140.d: अथोपवेषेणाङ्गारान् समूहतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् तूष्णीम् अङ्गारान् समूह्याथैनान् स्रुवाहुतिभिर् अभिजुहुयात् । अग्नये रक्षोघ्ने स्वाहा । इति पञ्चभिस् ।
22.17.140.m: "Then with the poker he sweeps together the embers": / this is the sūtra of Śālīki. / On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "Having silently swept together the embers, he should then pour offerings over them with ladle libations with the five [mantras beginning with]: 'To Agni, the slayer of rakṣases, svāhā.'
At this point he should give a chariot drawn by three horses."

22.17.141.s: apāmārgasaktūnām̐ homa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ samastenaivāsmai mantreṇāpāmārgasaktūñ juhuyāt
22.17.141.d: अपामार्गसक्तूनाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः समस्तेनैवास्मै मन्त्रेणापामार्गसक्तूञ् जुहुयात्
22.17.141.m: Regarding the offering of apāmārga groats: / this is the sūtra of Śālīki. / On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "With the mantra taken as a whole, he should offer the apāmārga groats for him;

22.17.141.s: tūṣṇīm̐ sruvam anupraharet tūṣṇīm upottiṣṭhed iti ||
22.17.141.d: तूष्णीँ स्रुवम् अनुप्रहरेत् तूष्णीम् उपोत्तिष्ठेद् इति ॥
22.17.141.m: he should throw the offering ladle into the fire silently; / he should rise silently."
Regarding the preparation of the Devikā oblations: / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.17.141.s: somam̐somam anuvarterann iti śālīkis | na devikāhavirbhir yajed ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
22.17.141.d: सोमँसोमम् अनुवर्तेरन्न् इति शालीकिस् । न देविकाहविर्भिर् यजेद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
22.17.141.m: "They should accompany each soma sacrifice," says Śālīki. / "He should not sacrifice with the Devikā oblations," says Āñjīgavi.

22.17.141.s: agnibhiḥ pratyavasāna iti || ajasraiḥ pratyavasyed iti baudhāyanas |
22.17.141.d: अग्निभिः प्रत्यवसान इति ॥ अजस्रैः प्रत्यवस्येद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.17.141.m: Regarding the return with the sacred fires: / "He should return with the perpetual fires," says Baudhāyana.
"Having caused them to mount into the two churning sticks," says Śālīki.

22.17.141.s: payasaḥ samāsecana iti || dṛtau vā vināḍe vā samāsiñced iti baudhāyanas |
22.17.141.d: पयसः समासेचन इति ॥ दृतौ वा विनाडे वा समासिञ्चेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.17.141.m: Regarding the pouring together of milk: / "He should pour it together into a leather bag or into a bamboo tube," says Baudhāyana.
"Into a new earthen vessel," says Śālīki.

22.17.141.s: svayaṃkṛteṣv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano gonyāsapramṛditānāṃ kuśānāṃ barhiḥ saṃnahyet svayaṃpatitānāṃ kāṣṭhānām idhmam |
22.17.141.d: स्वयंकृतेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो गोन्यासप्रमृदितानां कुशानां बर्हिः संनह्येत् स्वयंपतितानां काष्ठानाम् इध्मम् ।
22.17.141.m: Regarding [the materials] spontaneously produced: / this is the sūtra of Śālīki. / On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "He should bind sacrificial grass from kuśa crushed by the trampling of cows, and kindling wood from naturally fallen pieces of wood.

22.17.141.s: yad eva vedyai rūpam̐ sā vedis | dṛtiṃ vā vināḍaṃ vā ratha ādhāya parivahet |
22.17.141.d: यद् एव वेद्यै रूपँ सा वेदिस् । दृतिं वा विनाडं वा रथ आधाय परिवहेत् ।
22.17.141.m: Whatever is the natural shape of an altar, that is the altar. / Having placed the leather bag or bamboo tube on a chariot, he should convey it around.

22.17.141.s: yat tatra navanītam utsīdet tad ājyam̐ syād iti ||
22.17.141.d: यत् तत्र नवनीतम् उत्सीदेत् तद् आज्यँ स्याद् इति ॥
22.17.141.m: Whatever butter should rise to the top there, that should be the clarified butter."

22.17.141.s: maitrābārhaspatyasya nirvapaṇa iti || samānacaturmuṣṭī syātām iti baudhāyanas |
22.17.141.d: मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यस्य निर्वपण इति ॥ समानचतुर्मुष्टी स्याताम् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.17.141.m: Regarding the measuring out of the offering for Mitra and Bṛhaspati: / "There should be identical four-handful portions," says Baudhāyana.

22.17.142.m: "There should be separate four-handful portions," says Śālīki.

22.18.142.s: rohite carmaṇīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | apy arohitam̐ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.18.142.d: रोहिते चर्मणीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अप्य् अरोहितँ स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.18.142.m: Regarding [the placing] upon a red hide: / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. / "It may even be un-red," says Śālīki.

22.18.142.s: somakrayaṇeṣūpaite nityāḥ śate syur iti baudhāyanas | eta eva śatatamāḥ syur iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.18.142.d: सोमक्रयणेषूपैते नित्याः शते स्युर् इति बौधायनस् । एत एव शततमाः स्युर् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.18.142.m: Regarding the items for purchasing soma: / "These should be in addition to the regular hundred," says Baudhāyana. / "These very ones should be the hundredth," says Śālīki.

22.18.142.s: vasatīvarīṇāṃ grahaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sārasvatīr apy atra vasatīvarīr gṛhṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.18.142.d: वसतीवरीणां ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सारस्वतीर् अप्य् अत्र वसतीवरीर् गृह्णीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.18.142.m: Regarding the drawing of the vasatīvarī waters: / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. / "He should draw the Sarasvatī waters as the vasatīvarī waters here as well," says Śālīki.
"In place of the animal for Agni, an animal for Indra and Agni is to be seized": / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.18.142.s: aindrāgna eva savanīyaḥ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.18.142.d: ऐन्द्राग्न एव सवनीयः स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.18.142.m: "The animal for Indra and Agni should be the pressing animal itself," says Śālīki.

22.18.142.s: pātrāṇāṃ karaṇa iti || yathānirbhedaṃ pātrāṇi kārayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
22.18.142.d: पात्राणां करण इति ॥ यथानिर्भेदं पात्राणि कारयेद् इति बौधायनः
22.18.142.m: Regarding the making of the vessels: / "He should have the vessels made according to each specific modification," says Baudhāyana.
"They should be the primary ritual ones only," says Śālīki.

22.18.142.s: sārasvatīnām abhihoma iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yābhyām etad ṛgbhyāṃ vahantīr abhijuhuyāt tābhyāṃ grahegrahe juhuyāt |
22.18.142.d: सारस्वतीनाम् अभिहोम इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो याभ्याम् एतद् ऋग्भ्यां वहन्तीर् अभिजुहुयात् ताभ्यां ग्रहेग्रहे जुहुयात् ।
22.18.142.m: Regarding the offering into the Sarasvatī waters: / this is the sūtra of Śālīki. / On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "With the two verses with which he pours offerings over the flowing waters, with those two he should make an offering at each cup;
then he should offer into the Sarasvatī waters silently."

22.18.142.s: abhiṣecanīyānāṃ grahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos |
22.18.142.d: अभिषेचनीयानां ग्रहाणां ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् ।
22.18.142.m: Regarding the drawing of the cups of the unction: / this is the sūtra of both teachers.

22.18.142.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ purastāt sadaso 'bhiṣecanīyān grahān gṛhṇīyād iti ||
22.18.142.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः पुरस्तात् सदसो ऽभिषेचनीयान् ग्रहान् गृह्णीयाद् इति ॥
22.18.142.m: On this matter Aupamanyava indeed said: "He should draw the cups of the unction in front of the sadas shed."

22.18.142.s: dhanuṣaḥ pradāna iti || pūrvaḥh kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
22.18.142.d: धनुषः प्रदान इति ॥ पूर्वःह् कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
22.18.142.m: Regarding the handing over of the bow: / the earlier ritual option is Baudhāyana's, the later is Śālīki's.

22.18.143.s: mārutasyaikavim̐śatikapālasya kapālopadhāna iti || aiṣṭikair upadhāya gaṇair upadadhyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.18.143.d: मारुतस्यैकविँशतिकपालस्य कपालोपधान इति ॥ ऐष्टिकैर् उपधाय गणैर् उपदध्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.18.143.m: Regarding the laying down of the potsherds for the twenty-one-potsherd cake for the Maruts: / "Having laid them down with the formulas of the iṣṭi, he should lay them down with the troop-formulas," says Baudhāyana.

22.18.143.s: āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti || mantravatī syād iti baudhāyanas
22.18.143.d: आमिक्षायै मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवती स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
22.18.143.m: Regarding the accompanied or unaccompanied state of the curd mixture: / "It should be accompanied by a mantra," says Baudhāyana.

22.19.143.s: klībasya sthāna iti || antarvedi tiṣṭhed iti baudhāyanas |
22.19.143.d: क्लीबस्य स्थान इति ॥ अन्तर्वेदि तिष्ठेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.19.143.m: Regarding the standing place of the eunuch: / "He should stand within the altar," says Baudhāyana.

22.19.143.s: maṇīnāṃ karaṇa iti || audumbara audumbareṇa lauhena pracchannaḥ syād iti baudhāyanas |
22.19.143.d: मणीनां करण इति ॥ औदुम्बर औदुम्बरेण लौहेन प्रच्छन्नः स्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.19.143.m: Regarding the making of the beads: / "An udumbara bead should be covered with an udumbara [metal, namely] copper," says Baudhāyana.
"It should be purely of udumbara wood," says Śālīki.

22.19.143.s: tasmin saha saṃgrahītrā rathavāhane ratham ādadhātīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya |
22.19.143.d: तस्मिन् सह संग्रहीत्रा रथवाहने रथम् आदधातीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ।
22.19.143.m: "Upon that chariot-bearer he places the chariot together with the charioteer": / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.19.143.s: ādhātṛṇām evaikaḥ saṃgrahītā syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.19.143.d: आधातृणाम् एवैकः संग्रहीता स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.19.143.m: "One of the arrangers themselves should be the charioteer," says Śālīki.

22.19.143.s: sphyasya pradāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yajamānasyaivaikasya mantreṇa saṃprayacchet tūṣṇīm itare saṃprayaccherann iti ||
22.19.143.d: स्फ्यस्य प्रदान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यजमानस्यैवैकस्य मन्त्रेण संप्रयच्छेत् तूष्णीम् इतरे संप्रयच्छेरन्न् इति ॥
22.19.143.m: Regarding the handing over of the wooden sword: / this is the sūtra of Śālīki. / On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "He should hand it over to the sacrificer alone with a mantra; the others should hand it on silently."

22.19.143.s: akṣāṇāṃ karaṇa iti || sauvarṇāḥ syur iti baudhāyanas |
22.19.143.d: अक्षाणां करण इति ॥ सौवर्णाः स्युर् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.19.143.m: Regarding the making of the dice: / "They should be made of gold," says Baudhāyana.

22.19.143.s: rājatā iti śālīkis | nāgadantā ity aupamanyavas | vaibhītakā ity aupamanyavīputraḥ ||
22.19.143.d: राजता इति शालीकिस् । नागदन्ता इत्य् औपमन्यवस् । वैभीतका इत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रः ॥
22.19.143.m: "Of silver," says Śālīki. / "Of ivory," says Aupamanyava. / "Of vibhītaka wood," says Aupamanyavīputra.

22.19.143.s: athāsmai pañcākṣān apacchidya prayacchatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
22.19.143.d: अथास्मै पञ्चाक्षान् अपच्छिद्य प्रयच्छतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
22.19.143.m: "Then, having separated five dice, he hands them to him": / this is the sūtra of Śālīki.

22.19.144.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyano yenāsyānupapannam̐ syāt taṃ tatrāpisṛjed diśo 'bhy ayam̐ rājābhūd iti ||
22.19.144.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो येनास्यानुपपन्नँ स्यात् तं तत्रापिसृजेद् दिशो ऽभ्य् अयँ राजाभूद् इति ॥
22.19.144.m: On this matter Baudhāyana indeed said: "That by which his purpose would not be achieved, that he should add thereto, [reciting]: 'This king has become lord of the quarters.'"

22.19.144.s: atha viṣuvati darbhastambe juhotīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.19.144.d: अथ विषुवति दर्भस्तम्बे जुहोतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.19.144.m: "Then at the middle point he offers into a tuft of darbha grass": / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.19.144.s: yatraiva darbhastambaḥ syāt tad gacched iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.19.144.d: यत्रैव दर्भस्तम्बः स्यात् तद् गच्छेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.19.144.m: "He should go wherever there is a tuft of darbha grass," says Śālīki.

22.20.144.s: agnīnām̐ haraṇa iti || ajasrān hared iti baudhāyanas |
22.20.144.d: अग्नीनाँ हरण इति ॥ अजस्रान् हरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.20.144.m: Regarding the carrying of the sacred fires: / "He should carry the perpetual fires," says Baudhāyana.
"Having caused them to mount into the two churning sticks," says Śālīki.

22.20.144.s: vedyai karaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pūrvāpūrvā vedir bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.144.d: वेद्यै करण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पूर्वापूर्वा वेदिर् भवतीति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.144.m: Regarding the preparation of the altar: / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana. / "The altar becomes progressively prior," says Śālīki.

22.20.144.s: athainaṃ tīrthād ānīya pavayitvā puṇḍarisrajinam udānīyeti ||
22.20.144.d: अथैनं तीर्थाद् आनीय पवयित्वा पुण्डरिस्रजिनम् उदानीयेति ॥
22.20.144.m: "Then, having brought him from the water-approach, having purified him, having led him up wearing a lotus garland":

22.20.144.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayāni puṇḍarikāṇi karayet sauvarṇāni ca nādeyāni ceti
22.20.144.d: स ह स्माह बौधायन उभयानि पुण्डरिकाणि करयेत् सौवर्णानि च नादेयानि चेति
22.20.144.m: Baudhāyana indeed said: "He should have both kinds of lotuses prepared: both golden ones and river ones."

22.20.144.s: nidadhaty asmā etad dhavir ucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanam iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.20.144.d: निदधत्य् अस्मा एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टं व्रतभाजनम् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.20.144.m: "They deposit for him this oblation remnant, which is the vessel of his vow-food": / this is the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

22.20.144.s: nātra havir ucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanaṃ nidadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.144.d: नात्र हविर् उच्छिष्टं व्रतभाजनं निदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.144.m: "Here he should not deposit an oblation remnant as the vessel of his vow-food," says Śālīki.

22.20.144.s: somakrayaṇeṣūpaite nityāḥ syur iti baudhāyanas | eta eva syur iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.144.d: सोमक्रयणेषूपैते नित्याः स्युर् इति बौधायनस् । एत एव स्युर् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.144.m: Regarding the items for purchasing soma: / "These should be in addition to the regular ones," says Baudhāyana. / "These very ones should be [them]," says Śālīki.

22.20.145.s: aupasadām̐ haviṣāṃ mantrāmantra iti || mantravanti syur iti baudhāyanas
22.20.145.d: औपसदाँ हविषां मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवन्ति स्युर् इति बौधायनस्
22.20.145.m: Regarding the accompanied or unaccompanied state of the Upasad oblations: / "They should be accompanied by mantras," says Baudhāyana.

22.20.145.s: āgneyasya prājāpatyas tūpara upālambhyo bhavatīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
22.20.145.d: आग्नेयस्य प्राजापत्यस् तूपर उपालम्भ्यो भवतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
22.20.145.m: Regarding the rule: "To the [victim] sacred to Agni, a hornless [he-goat] sacred to Prajāpati is additionally attached"—the sūtra is Baudhāyana's.

22.20.145.s: prājāpatya eva savanīyaḥ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.145.d: प्राजापत्य एव सवनीयः स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.145.m: "The one sacred to Prajāpati alone should be the soma-offering victim," says Śālīki.

22.20.145.s: bhārgavo hotā bhavatīti || ādita eva bhārgavam̐ hotāraṃ vṛṇīteti baudhāyanas |
22.20.145.d: भार्गवो होता भवतीति ॥ आदित एव भार्गवँ होतारं वृणीतेति बौधायनस् ।
22.20.145.m: Regarding the rule: "A descendant of Bhṛgu is the hotṛ priest"—"Right from the beginning he should choose a descendant of Bhṛgu as hotṛ priest," says Baudhāyana.

22.20.145.s: daśapeya eva bhārgavo hotā syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.145.d: दशपेय एव भार्गवो होता स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.145.m: "Only at the Daśapeya should a descendant of Bhṛgu be the hotṛ priest," says Śālīki.

22.20.145.s: śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ pibantīti || yajamāna ekaśatatamaḥ syād iti baudhāyanas |
22.20.145.d: शतं ब्राह्मणाः पिबन्तीति ॥ यजमान एकशततमः स्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.20.145.m: Regarding the rule: "A hundred brāhmaṇas drink"—"The sacrificer should be the hundred and first," says Baudhāyana.

22.20.145.s: yajamāna eva śatatamaḥ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.20.145.d: यजमान एव शततमः स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.20.145.m: "The sacrificer himself should be the hundredth," says Śālīki.

22.20.145.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti || etā eva brāhmaṇābhivihitā dakṣiṇā dadyād iti baudhāyanas |
22.20.145.d: दक्षिणानां दान इति ॥ एता एव ब्राह्मणाभिविहिता दक्षिणा दद्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.20.145.m: Regarding the giving of the priestly fees—"He should give only these priestly fees that are prescribed in the brāhmaṇa passage," says Baudhāyana.
"This is the principal thousand," says Śālīki.

22.21.145.s: teṣām utthāneṣv iti || gaccheyur āvabhṛthād iti baudhāyanas |
22.21.145.d: तेषाम् उत्थानेष्व् इति ॥ गच्छेयुर् आवभृथाद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.21.145.m: Regarding their rising [from the session]—"They should go until the avabhṛtha," says Baudhāyana.

22.21.145.s: apsuṣomāntā iti śālīkis | dhruvāntā ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
22.21.145.d: अप्सुषोमान्ता इति शालीकिस् । ध्रुवान्ता इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
22.21.145.m: "They end with the soma in water," says Śālīki; "they end with the dhruvā cup," says Aupamanyava.

22.21.145.s: haviṣohaviṣa iṣṭvā bārhaspatyam abhighārayatīti || bārhaspatyasyāpīṣṭvā bārhaspatyam abhighārayed iti baudhāyanas |
22.21.145.d: हविषोहविष इष्ट्वा बार्हस्पत्यम् अभिघारयतीति ॥ बार्हस्पत्यस्यापीष्ट्वा बार्हस्पत्यम् अभिघारयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.21.145.m: Regarding the rule: "Having sacrificed each oblation, he bastes the [oblation] sacred to Bṛhaspati"—"Even after having sacrificed the [oblation] sacred to Bṛhaspati, he should baste the [oblation] sacred to Bṛhaspati," says Baudhāyana.

22.21.146.s: itareṣām eva haviṣāṃ na bārhaspatyasyeti śālīkiḥ ||
22.21.146.d: इतरेषाम् एव हविषां न बार्हस्पत्यस्येति शालीकिः ॥
22.21.146.m: "Only of the other oblations, not of the one sacred to Bṛhaspati," says Śālīki.

22.21.146.s: uccair ādityāyā āśrāvayaty upām̐śu mārutyā iti ||
22.21.146.d: उच्चैर् आदित्याया आश्रावयत्य् उपाँशु मारुत्या इति ॥
22.21.146.m: Regarding the rule: "Aloud he makes the call for the [victim] sacred to the Ādityas, silently for the one sacred to the Maruts"—

22.21.146.s: ādityāśrāvaṇaprabhṛty upām̐śv athetarad uccair iti baudhāyanas | ā mārutyāśrāvaṇaprabhṛty upām̐śv athetarad uccair iti śālīkiḥ
22.21.146.d: आदित्याश्रावणप्रभृत्य् उपाँश्व् अथेतरद् उच्चैर् इति बौधायनस् । आ मारुत्याश्रावणप्रभृत्य् उपाँश्व् अथेतरद् उच्चैर् इति शालीकिः
22.21.146.m: "Beginning from the call for the [victim] sacred to the Ādityas it is silent, then the other is aloud," says Baudhāyana; "beginning from the call for the [victim] sacred to the Maruts it is silent, then the other is aloud," says Śālīki.
"The one sacred to the Ādityas is entirely aloud, the one sacred to the Maruts is entirely silent," says Aupamanyava.

22.21.146.s: sātyadūteṣv iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | imaṃ te 'sau prāhaiṣīt | ity eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.21.146.d: सात्यदूतेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । इमं ते ऽसौ प्राहैषीत् । इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.21.146.m: Regarding the sātyadūta offerings—the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "He should simply say: 'So-and-so has sent this to you,'" says Śālīki.

22.21.146.s: dvirātra iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yajanīye 'han pūrvam ahar bhavaty uttarasminn uttaram iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.21.146.d: द्विरात्र इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यजनीये ऽहन् पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् उत्तरस्मिन्न् उत्तरम् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.21.146.m: Regarding the two-night ritual—the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. "On the sacrifice day is the first day, on the following day is the second," says Śālīki.

22.21.146.s: devikāhaviṣāṃ karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
22.21.146.d: देविकाहविषां करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
22.21.146.m: Regarding the performance of the devikā oblations—"He should perform it," says Baudhāyana.

22.21.146.s: na kuryād iti śālīkir na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
22.21.146.d: न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिर् न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
22.21.146.m: "He should not perform it," says Śālīki; "he should not perform it," says Śālīki.

23.1.147.m: Now next we shall explain the procedure for the supplementary offerings.

23.1.147.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pañcadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syur vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgāv uccairdevatā iti |
23.1.147.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनः पञ्चदशसामिधेनीकाः स्युर् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागाव् उच्चैर्देवता इति ।
23.1.147.m: Baudhāyana used to say: "They should have fifteen kindling verses, the two butter-portions should contain the word 'slayer of Vṛtra', and the deities should be [addressed] aloud."

23.1.147.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ saptadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syur vṛdhanvantāv ājyabhāgāv upām̐śudevatā iti ||
23.1.147.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः सप्तदशसामिधेनीकाः स्युर् वृधन्वन्ताव् आज्यभागाव् उपाँशुदेवता इति ॥
23.1.147.m: Here Śālīki used to say: "They should have seventeen kindling verses, the two butter-portions should contain the word 'prosperous', and the deities should be [addressed] silently."

23.1.147.s: yājamānasya karaṇa iti || sam̐siddham iṣṭipathe yājamānaṃ kuryād iti baudhāyanaḥ
23.1.147.d: याजमानस्य करण इति ॥ सँसिद्धम् इष्टिपथे याजमानं कुर्याद् इति बौधायनः
23.1.147.m: Regarding the performance of the sacrificer's duties—"He should perform the sacrificer's duties in an established manner along the course of the supplementary offering," says Baudhāyana.
"He should perform the sacrificer's duties according to the proper occasions," says Śālīki.

23.1.147.s: agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sann amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vātipādayed iti ||
23.1.147.d: अग्नये पथिकृते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यो दर्शपूर्णमासयाजी सन्न् अमावास्यां वा पौर्णमासीं वातिपादयेद् इति ॥
23.1.147.m: Regarding the rule: "One who, being an offerer of the new and full moon rituals, should let either the new moon ritual or the full moon ritual elapse, should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Pathikṛt"—

23.1.147.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pāthikṛtaṃ nirupya vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam anunirvaped athātipannāṃ pratiyajed iti |
23.1.147.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनः पाथिकृतं निरुप्य वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालम् अनुनिर्वपेद् अथातिपन्नां प्रतियजेद् इति ।
23.1.147.m: Baudhāyana used to say: "Having offered the one to Pathikṛt, he should additionally offer a [cake] on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara, and then perform the omitted ritual."

23.1.147.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ pāthikṛtaṃ nirupya vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam̐ samānatantram anunirvapen na cātipannāṃ pratiyajed iti |
23.1.147.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः पाथिकृतं निरुप्य वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालँ समानतन्त्रम् अनुनिर्वपेन् न चातिपन्नां प्रतियजेद् इति ।
23.1.147.m: Here Śālīki used to say: "Having offered the one to Pathikṛt, he should additionally offer a [cake] on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara under the same ritual framework, and he should not perform the omitted ritual."
"Together with either one of the two he should perform the omitted ritual," says Aupamanyava.

23.1.147.s: atro ha smāhāñjīgavir vi vā etasya yajñaś chidyate yasya tantre pratate 'nyat tantraṃ pratāyate
23.1.147.d: अत्रो ह स्माहाञ्जीगविर् वि वा एतस्य यज्ञश् छिद्यते यस्य तन्त्रे प्रतते ऽन्यत् तन्त्रं प्रतायते
23.1.147.m: Here Añjīgavi used to say: "Indeed, his sacrifice is severed, in whose stretched-out ritual framework another ritual framework is stretched out."

23.1.147.s: ya evaiṣo 'cyuta āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālastam eva paurṇamāsyāṃ vāmāvāsyāyāṃ vā pāthikṛtaṃ kuryān na cātipannāṃ pratiyajed iti ||
23.1.147.d: य एवैषो ऽच्युत आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालस्तम् एव पौर्णमास्यां वामावास्यायां वा पाथिकृतं कुर्यान् न चातिपन्नां प्रतियजेद् इति ॥
23.1.147.m: "The constant [cake] on eight potsherds sacred to Agni—that very one he should make sacred to Pathikṛt at the full moon ritual or at the new moon ritual; and he should not perform an expiatory sacrifice for an omitted [ritual]," [says Āñjīgavi].

23.1.147.s: agnaye vratapataye puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped ya āhitāgniḥ sann avratyam iva cared iti ||
23.1.147.d: अग्नये व्रतपतये पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् य आहिताग्निः सन्न् अव्रत्यम् इव चरेद् इति ॥
23.1.147.m: "He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Vratapati if he, having established the sacred fires, should act, as it were, contrary to his vows." [Regarding this:]

23.1.148.m: "This is declared [to apply] right from the establishment of the sacred fires onwards," says Baudhāyana.
"[Only] when the fuel has been added and the fires have been built up," says Śālīki.

23.1.148.s: agnaye rakṣoghne puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yam̐ rakṣām̐si saceran | iti ||
23.1.148.d: अग्नये रक्षोघ्ने पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यँ रक्षाँसि सचेरन् । इति ॥
23.1.148.m: "He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Rakṣohan if demons should attach themselves to him." [Regarding this:]
"Having offered the agnihotra, he should conclude the rite," says Baudhāyana.

23.1.148.s: sam̐sthitāyām iṣṭyām agnihotraṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.1.148.d: सँस्थितायाम् इष्ट्याम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.1.148.m: "When the rite is concluded, he should offer the agnihotra," says Śālīki.

23.1.148.s: agnaye rudravate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped abhicaran | iti ||
23.1.148.d: अग्नये रुद्रवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् अभिचरन् । इति ॥
23.1.148.m: "He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Rudravat when practicing sorcery." [Regarding this:]

23.1.148.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyano lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavāsasaś cartvijaḥ pracareyur iti
23.1.148.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनो लोहितोष्णीषा लोहितवाससश् चर्त्विजः प्रचरेयुर् इति
23.1.148.m: Baudhāyana used to say: "Wearing red turbans and wearing red garments, the officiating priests should perform [the rites]."
"This is declared through the offering and invitatory verses alone," says Śālīki.

23.1.148.s: agnaye surabhimate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yasya gāvo vā puruṣā vā pramīyeran yo vā bibhīyāt | iti ||
23.1.148.d: अग्नये सुरभिमते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यस्य गावो वा पुरुषा वा प्रमीयेरन् यो वा बिभीयात् । इति ॥
23.1.148.m: "He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Surabhimat if his cattle or men should die, or if he should be afraid." [Regarding this:]

23.1.148.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prokṣaṇīṣu ca gandhān āvapeyur gandhavantaś cartvijaḥ pracareyur iti
23.1.148.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रोक्षणीषु च गन्धान् आवपेयुर् गन्धवन्तश् चर्त्विजः प्रचरेयुर् इति
23.1.148.m: Baudhāyana used to say: "They should throw fragrant substances into the sprinkling waters, and fragrant officiating priests should perform [the rites]."
"This is declared through the offering and invitatory verses alone," says Śālīki.

23.1.148.s: agnaye kāmāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yaṃ kāmo nopanamet | iti ||
23.1.148.d: अग्नये कामाय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यं कामो नोपनमेत् । इति ॥
23.1.148.m: "He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Kāma if a desire does not fall to his lot." [Regarding this:]

23.1.148.s: sa ha smāha baudhāyano yā tatrāmnātā syāt tāṃ cen nirvapataḥ kāmo na samṛdhyetāthaivaṃ kuryād iti |
23.1.148.d: स ह स्माह बौधायनो या तत्राम्नाता स्यात् तां चेन् निर्वपतः कामो न समृध्येताथैवं कुर्याद् इति ।
23.1.148.m: Baudhāyana used to say: "If, while he offers that which is prescribed for it, the desire is not fulfilled, then he should do this."
